1.zh: 以色列王大卫儿子所罗门的箴言：
1.en: The proverbs of Solomon son ofDavid, king of Israel:

1.zh: 要使人晓得智慧和训诲，分辨通达的言语，
1.en: for attaining wisdom and discipline; for understanding words of insight;

1.zh: 使人处事领受智慧 、 仁义 、 公平 、 正直的训诲，
1.en: for acquiring a disciplined and prudent life, doing what is right and just and fair;

1.zh: 使愚人灵明，使少年人有知识和谋略，
1.en: for giving prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young-

1.zh: 使智慧人听见，增长学问，使聪明人得著智谋
1.en: let the wise listen and add to their learning, and let the discerning get guidance-

1.zh: 使人明白箴言和譬喻，懂得智慧人的言词和谜语。
1.en: for understanding proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.

1.zh: 敬畏耶和华是知识的开端；愚妄人藐视智慧和训诲。
1.en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline. Exhortations to Embrace Wisdom

1.zh: 我儿，要听你父亲的训诲，不可离弃你母亲的法则（或译：指教）；
1.en: Listen, my son, to your father's instruction and do not forsake your mother's teaching.

1.zh: 因为这要作你头上的华冠，你项上的金炼。
1.en: They will be a garland to grace your head and a chain to adorn your neck.

1.zh: 我儿，恶人若引诱你，你不可随从。
1.en: My son, if sinners entice you, do not give in to them.

1.zh: 他们若说：你与我们同去，我们要埋伏流人之血，要蹲伏害无罪之人；
1.en: If they say, "Come along with us; let's lie in wait for someone's blood, let's waylay some harmless soul;

1.zh: 我们好像阴间，把他们活活吞下；他们如同下坑的人，被我们囫囵吞了；
1.en: let's swallow them alive, like the grave, and whole, like those who go down to the pit;

1.zh: 我们必得各样宝物，将所掳来的，装满房屋；
1.en: we will get all sorts of valuable things and fill our houses with plunder;

1.zh: 你与我们大家同分，我们共用一个囊袋；
1.en: throw in your lot with us, and we will share a common purse"-

1.zh: 我儿，不要与他们同行一道，禁止你脚走他们的路。
1.en: my son, do not go along with them, do not set foot on their paths;

1.zh: 因为，他们的脚奔跑行恶；他们急速流人的血，
1.en: for their feet rush into sin, they are swift to shed blood.

1.zh: 好像飞鸟，网罗设在眼前仍不躲避。
1.en: How useless to spread a net in full view of all the birds!

1.zh: 这些人埋伏，是为自流己血；蹲伏，是为自害己命。
1.en: These men lie in wait for their own blood; they waylay only themselves!

1.zh: 凡贪恋财利的，所行之路都是如此；这贪恋之心乃夺去得财者之命。
1.en: Such is the end of all who go after ill-gotten gain; it takes away the lives of those who get it.

1.zh: 智慧在街市上呼喊，在宽阔处发声，
1.en: Wisdom calls aloud in the street, she raises her voice in the public squares;

1.zh: 在热闹街头喊叫，在城门口，在城中发出言语，
1.en: at the head of the noisy streets she cries out, in the gateways of the city she makes her speech:

1.zh: 说：你们愚昧人喜爱愚昧，亵慢人喜欢亵慢，愚顽人恨恶知识，要到几时呢？
1.en: "How long will you simple ones love your simple ways? How long will mockers delight in mockery and fools hate knowledge?

1.zh: 你们当因我的责备回转；我要将我的灵浇灌你们，将我的话指示你们。
1.en: If you had responded to my rebuke, I would have poured out my heart to you and made my thoughts known to you.

1.zh: 我呼唤，你们不肯听从；我伸手，无人理会；
1.en: But since you rejected me when I called and no one gave heed when I stretched out my hand,

1.zh: 反轻弃我一切的劝戒，不肯受我的责备。
1.en: since you ignored all my advice and would not accept my rebuke,

1.zh: 你们遭灾难，我就发笑；惊恐临到你们，我必嗤笑。
1.en: I in turn will laugh at your disaster; I will mock when calamity overtakes you-

1.zh: 惊恐临到你们，好像狂风；灾难来到，如同暴风；急难痛苦临到你们身上。
1.en: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster sweeps over you like a whirlwind, when distress and trouble overwhelm you.

1.zh: 那时，你们必呼求我，我却不答应，恳切地寻找我，却寻不见。
1.en: "Then they will call to me but I will not answer; they will look for me but will not find me.

1.zh: 因为，你们恨恶知识，不喜爱敬畏耶和华，
1.en: Since they hated knowledge and did not choose to fear the Lord ,

1.zh: 不听我的劝戒，藐视我一切的责备，
1.en: since they would not accept my advice and spurned my rebuke,

1.zh: 所以必吃自结的果子，充满自设的计谋 . 。
1.en: they will eat the fruit of their ways and be filled with the fruit of their schemes.

1.zh: 愚昧人背道，必杀己身；愚顽人安逸，必害己命。
1.en: For the waywardness of the simple will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them;

1.zh: 惟有听从我的，必安然居住，得享安静，不怕灾祸。
1.en: but whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm."

2.zh: 我儿，你若领受我的言语，存记我的命令，
2.en: My son, if you accept my words andstore up my commands within you,

2.zh: 侧耳听智慧，专心求聪明，
2.en: turning your ear to wisdom and applying your heart to understanding,

2.zh: 呼求明哲，扬声求聪明，
2.en: and if you call out for insight and cry aloud for understanding,

2.zh: 寻找他，如寻找银子，搜求他，如搜求隐藏的珍宝，
2.en: and if you look for it as for silver and search for it as for hidden treasure,

2.zh: 你就明白敬畏耶和华，得以认识神。
2.en: then you will understand the fear of the Lord and find the knowledge of God.

2.zh: 因为，耶和华赐人智慧；知识和聪明都由他口而出。
2.en: For the Lord gives wisdom, and from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

2.zh: 他给正直人存留真智慧，给行为纯正的人作盾牌，
2.en: He holds victory in store for the upright, he is a shield to those whose walk is blameless,

2.zh: 为要保守公平人的路，护庇虔敬人的道。
2.en: for he guards the course of the just and protects the way of his faithful ones.

2.zh: 你也必明白仁义 、 公平 、 正直 、 一切的善道。
2.en: Then you will understand what is right and just and fair-every good path.

2.zh: 智慧必入你心；你的灵要以知识为美。
2.en: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

2.zh: 谋略必护卫你；聪明必保守你，
2.en: Discretion will protect you, and understanding will guard you.

2.zh: 要救你脱离恶道（或译：恶人的道），脱离说乖谬话的人。
2.en: Wisdom will save you from the ways of wicked men, from men whose words are perverse,

2.zh: 那等人舍弃正直的路，行走黑暗的道，
2.en: who leave the straight paths to walk in dark ways,

2.zh: 欢喜作恶，喜爱恶人的乖僻，
2.en: who delight in doing wrong and rejoice in the perverseness of evil,

2.zh: 在他们的道中弯曲，在他们的路上偏僻。
2.en: whose paths are crooked and who are devious in their ways.

2.zh: 智慧要救你脱离淫妇，就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。
2.en: It will save you also from the adulteress, from the wayward wife with her seductive words,

2.zh: 他离弃幼年的配偶，忘了神的盟约。
2.en: who has left the partner of her youth and ignored the covenant she made before God.

2.zh: 他的家陷入死地；他的路偏向阴间。
2.en: For her house leads down to death and her paths to the spirits of the dead.

2.zh: 凡到他那里去的，不得转回，也得不著生命的路。
2.en: None who go to her return or attain the paths of life.

2.zh: 智慧必使你行善人的道，守义人的路。
2.en: Thus you will walk in the ways of good men and keep to the paths of the righteous.

2.zh: 正直人必在世上居住；完全人必在地上存留。
2.en: For the upright will live in the land, and the blameless will remain in it;

2.zh: 惟有恶人必然剪除；奸诈的，必然拔出。
2.en: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be torn from it.

3.zh: 我儿，不要忘记我的法则（或译：指教）；你心要谨守我的诫命；
3.en: My son, do not forget my teaching,but keep my commands in your heart,

3.zh: 因为他必将长久的日子，生命的年数与平安，加给你。
3.en: for they will prolong your life many years and bring you prosperity.

3.zh: 不可使慈爱 、 诚实离开你，要系在你颈项上，刻在你心版上。
3.en: Let love and faithfulness never leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.

3.zh: 这样，你必在神和世人眼前蒙恩宠，有聪明。
3.en: Then you will win favor and a good name in the sight of God and man.

3.zh: 你要专心仰赖耶和华，不可倚靠自己的聪明，
3.en: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding;

3.zh: 在你一切所行的事上都要认定他，他必指引你的路。
3.en: in all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

3.zh: 不要自以为有智慧；要敬畏耶和华，远离恶事。
3.en: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the Lord and shun evil.

3.zh: 这便医治你的肚脐，滋润你的百骨。
3.en: This will bring health to your body and nourishment to your bones.

3.zh: 你要以财物和一切初熟的土产尊荣耶和华。
3.en: Honor the Lord with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops;

3.zh: 这样，你的仓房必充满有余；你的酒醡有新酒盈溢。
3.en: then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine.

3.zh: 我儿，你不可轻看耶和华的管教（或译：惩治），也不可厌烦他的责备；
3.en: My son, do not despise the Lord 's discipline and do not resent his rebuke,

3.zh: 因为耶和华所爱的，他必责备，正如父亲责备所喜爱的儿子。
3.en: because the Lord disciplines those he loves, as a father the son he delights in.

3.zh: 得智慧，得聪明的，这人便为有福。
3.en: Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gains understanding,

3.zh: 因为得智慧胜过得银子，其利益强如精金，
3.en: for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.

3.zh: 比珍珠（或译：红宝石）宝贵；你一切所喜爱的，都不足与比较。
3.en: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.

3.zh: 他右手有长寿，左手有富贵。
3.en: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.

3.zh: 他的道是安乐；他的路全是平安。
3.en: Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.

3.zh: 他与持守他的作生命树；持定他的，俱各有福。
3.en: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her; those who lay hold of her will be blessed.

3.zh: 耶和华以智慧立地，以聪明定天，
3.en: By wisdom the Lord laid the earth's foundations, by understanding he set the heavens in place;

3.zh: 以知识使深渊裂开，使天空滴下甘露。
3.en: by his knowledge the deeps were divided, and the clouds let drop the dew.

3.zh: 我儿，要谨守真智慧和谋略，不可使他离开你的眼目。
3.en: My son, preserve sound judgment and discernment, do not let them out of your sight;

3.zh: 这样，他必作你的生命，颈项的美饰。
3.en: they will be life for you, an ornament to grace your neck.

3.zh: 你就坦然行路，不致碰脚。
3.en: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble;

3.zh: 你躺下，必不惧怕；你躺卧，睡得香甜。
3.en: when you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

3.zh: 忽然来的惊恐，不要害怕；恶人遭毁灭，也不要恐惧。
3.en: Have no fear of sudden disaster or of the ruin that overtakes the wicked,

3.zh: 因为耶和华是你所倚靠的；他必保守你的脚不陷入网罗。
3.en: for the Lord will be your confidence and will keep your foot from being snared.

3.zh: 你手若有行善的力量，不可推辞，就当向那应得的人施行。
3.en: Do not withhold good from those who deserve it, when it is in your power to act.

3.zh: 你那里若有现成的，不可对邻舍说：去罢，明天再来，我必给你。
3.en: Do not say to your neighbor, "Come back later; I'll give it tomorrow"- when you now have it with you.

3.zh: 你的邻舍既在你附近安居，你不可设计害他。
3.en: Do not plot harm against your neighbor, who lives trustfully near you.

3.zh: 人未曾加害与你，不可无故与他相争。
3.en: Do not accuse a man for no reason-when he has done you no harm.

3.zh: 不可嫉妒强暴的人，也不可选择他所行的路。
3.en: Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways,

3.zh: 因为，乖僻人为耶和华所憎恶；正直人为他所亲密。
3.en: for the Lord detests a perverse man but takes the upright into his confidence.

3.zh: 耶和华咒诅恶人的家庭，赐福与义人的居所。
3.en: The Lord 's curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.

3.zh: 他讥诮那好讥诮的人，赐恩给谦卑的人。
3.en: He mocks proud mockers but gives grace to the humble.

3.zh: 智慧人必承受尊荣；愚昧人高升也成为羞辱。
3.en: The wise inherit honor, but fools he holds up to shame.

4.zh: 众子啊，要听父亲的教训，留心得知聪明。
4.en: Listen, my sons, to a father's instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.

4.zh: 因我所给你们的是好教训；不可离弃我的法则（或译：指教）。
4.en: I give you sound learning, so do not forsake my teaching.

4.zh: 我在父亲面前为孝子，在母亲眼中为独一的娇儿。
4.en: When I was a boy in my father's house, still tender, and an only child of my mother,

4.zh: 父亲教训我说：你心要存记我的言语，遵守我的命令，便得存活。
4.en: he taught me and said, "Lay hold of my words with all your heart; keep my commands and you will live.

4.zh: 要得智慧，要得聪明，不可忘记，也不可偏离我口中的言语。
4.en: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or swerve from them.

4.zh: 不可离弃智慧，智慧就护卫你；要爱他，他就保守你。
4.en: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will protect you; love her, and she will watch over you.

4.zh: 智慧为首；所以，要得智慧。在你一切所得之内必得聪明 . （或译：用你一切所得的去换聪明）。
4.en: Wisdom is supreme; therefore get wisdom. Though it cost all you have, get understanding.

4.zh: 高举智慧，他就使你高升；怀抱智慧，他就使你尊荣。
4.en: Esteem her, and she will exalt you; embrace her, and she will honor you.

4.zh: 他必将华冠加在你头上，把荣冕交给你。
4.en: She will set a garland of grace on your head and present you with a crown of splendor."

4.zh: 我儿，你要听受我的言语，就必延年益寿。
4.en: Listen, my son, accept what I say, and the years of your life will be many.

4.zh: 我已指教你走智慧的道，引导你行正直的路。
4.en: I guide you in the way of wisdom and lead you along straight paths.

4.zh: 你行走，脚步必不致狭窄；你奔跑，也不致跌倒。
4.en: When you walk, your steps will not be hampered; when you run, you will not stumble.

4.zh: 要持定训诲，不可放松；必当谨守，因为他是你的生命。
4.en: Hold on to instruction, do not let it go; guard it well, for it is your life.

4.zh: 不可行恶人的路；不要走坏人的道。
4.en: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evil men.

4.zh: 要躲避，不可经过；要转身而去。
4.en: Avoid it, do not travel on it; turn from it and go on your way.

4.zh: 这等人若不行恶，不得睡觉；不使人跌倒，睡卧不安；
4.en: For they cannot sleep till they do evil; they are robbed of slumber till they make someone fall.

4.zh: 因为他们以奸恶吃饼，以强暴喝酒。
4.en: They eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

4.zh: 但义人的路好像黎明的光，越照越明，直到日午。
4.en: The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.

4.zh: 恶人的道好像幽暗，自己不知因甚么跌倒。
4.en: But the way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.

4.zh: 我儿，要留心听我的言词，侧耳听我的话语，
4.en: My son, pay attention to what I say; listen closely to my words.

4.zh: 都不可离你的眼目，要存记在你心中。
4.en: Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart;

4.zh: 因为得著他的，就得了生命，又得了医全体的良药。
4.en: for they are life to those who find them and health to a man's whole body.

4.zh: 你要保守你心，胜过保守一切（或译：你要切切保守你心），因为一生的果效是由心发出。
4.en: Above all else, guard your heart, for it is the wellspring of life.

4.zh: 你要除掉邪僻的口，弃绝乖谬的嘴。
4.en: Put away perversity from your mouth; keep corrupt talk far from your lips.

4.zh: 你的眼目要向前正看；你的眼睛（原文是皮）当向前直观。
4.en: Let your eyes look straight ahead, fix your gaze directly before you.

4.zh: 要修平你脚下的路，坚定你一切的道。
4.en: Make level paths for your feet and take only ways that are firm.

4.zh: 不可偏向左右；要使你的脚离开邪恶。
4.en: Do not swerve to the right or the left; keep your foot from evil.

5.zh: 我儿，要留心我智慧的话语，侧耳听我聪明的言词，
5.en: My son, pay attention to my wisdom,listen well to my words of insight,

5.zh: 为要使你谨守谋略，嘴唇保存知识。
5.en: that you may maintain discretion and your lips may preserve knowledge.

5.zh: 因为淫妇的嘴滴下蜂蜜；他的口比油更滑，
5.en: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil;

5.zh: 至终却苦似茵 𫈟 ，快如两刃的刀。
5.en: but in the end she is bitter as gall, sharp as a double-edged sword.

5.zh: 他的脚下入死地；他脚步踏住阴间，
5.en: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.

5.zh: 以致他找不著生命平坦的道。他的路变迁不定，自己还不知道。
5.en: She gives no thought to the way of life; her paths are crooked, but she knows it not.

5.zh: 众子啊，现在要听从我；不可离弃我口中的话。
5.en: Now then, my sons, listen to me; do not turn aside from what I say.

5.zh: 你所行的道要离他远，不可就近他的房门，
5.en: Keep to a path far from her, do not go near the door of her house,

5.zh: 恐怕将你的尊荣给别人，将你的岁月给残忍的人；
5.en: lest you give your best strength to others and your years to one who is cruel,

5.zh: 恐怕外人满得你的力量，你劳碌得来的，归入外人的家；
5.en: lest strangers feast on your wealth and your toil enrich another man's house.

5.zh: 终久，你皮肉和身体消毁，你就悲叹，
5.en: At the end of your life you will groan, when your flesh and body are spent.

5.zh: 说：我怎么恨恶训诲，心中藐视责备，
5.en: You will say, "How I hated discipline! How my heart spurned correction!

5.zh: 也不听从我师傅的话，又不侧耳听那教训我的人？
5.en: I would not obey my teachers or listen to my instructors.

5.zh: 我在圣会里，几乎落在诸般恶中。
5.en: I have come to the brink of utter ruin in the midst of the whole assembly."

5.zh: 你要喝自己池中的水，饮自己井里的活水。
5.en: Drink water from your own cistern, running water from your own well.

5.zh: 你的泉源岂可涨溢在外？你的河水岂可流在街上？
5.en: Should your springs overflow in the streets, your streams of water in the public squares?

5.zh: 惟独归你一人，不可与外人同用。
5.en: Let them be yours alone, never to be shared with strangers.

5.zh: 要使你的泉源蒙福；要喜悦你幼年所娶的妻。
5.en: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth.

5.zh: 他如可爱的麀鹿，可喜的母鹿；愿他的胸怀使你时时知足，他的爱情使你常常恋慕。
5.en: A loving doe, a graceful deer- may her breasts satisfy you always, may you ever be captivated by her love.

5.zh: 我儿，你为何恋慕淫妇？为何抱外女的胸怀？
5.en: Why be captivated, my son, by an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another man's wife?

5.zh: 因为，人所行的道都在耶和华眼前；他也修平人一切的路。
5.en: For a man's ways are in full view of the Lord , and he examines all his paths.

5.zh: 恶人必被自己的罪孽捉住；他必被自己的罪恶如绳索缠绕。
5.en: The evil deeds of a wicked man ensnare him; the cords of his sin hold him fast.

5.zh: 他因不受训诲就必死亡；又因愚昧过甚，必走差了路。
5.en: He will die for lack of discipline, led astray by his own great folly.

6.zh: 我儿，你若为朋友作保，替外人击掌，
6.en: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have struck hands in pledge for another,

6.zh: 你就被口中的话语缠住，被嘴里的言语捉住。
6.en: if you have been trapped by what you said, ensnared by the words of your mouth,

6.zh: 我儿，你既落在朋友手中，就当这样行才可救自己：你要自卑，去恳求你的朋友。
6.en: then do this, my son, to free yourself, since you have fallen into your neighbor's hands: Go and humble yourself; press your plea with your neighbor!

6.zh: 不要容你的眼睛睡觉；不要容你的眼皮打盹。
6.en: Allow no sleep to your eyes, no slumber to your eyelids.

6.zh: 要救自己，如鹿脱离猎户的手，如鸟脱离捕鸟人的手。
6.en: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

6.zh: 懒惰人哪，你去察看蚂蚁的动作就可得智慧。
6.en: Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider its ways and be wise!

6.zh: 蚂蚁没有元帅，没有官长，没有君王，
6.en: It has no commander, no overseer or ruler,

6.zh: 尚且在夏天预备食物，在收割时聚敛粮食。
6.en: yet it stores its provisions in summer and gathers its food at harvest.

6.zh: 懒惰人哪，你要睡到几时呢？你何时睡醒呢？
6.en: How long will you lie there, you sluggard? When will you get up from your sleep?

6.zh: 再睡片时，打盹片时，抱著手躺卧片时，
6.en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest-

6.zh: 你的贫穷就必如强盗速来，你的缺乏彷佛拿兵器的人来到。
6.en: and poverty will come on you like a bandit and scarcity like an armed man.

6.zh: 无赖的恶徒，行动就用乖僻的口，
6.en: A scoundrel and villain, who goes about with a corrupt mouth,

6.zh: 用眼传神，用脚示意，用指点划，
6.en: who winks with his eye, signals with his feet and motions with his fingers,

6.zh: 心中乖僻，常设恶谋，布散纷争。
6.en: who plots evil with deceit in his heart-he always stirs up dissension.

6.zh: 所以，灾难必忽然临到他身；他必顷刻败坏，无法可治。
6.en: Therefore disaster will overtake him in an instant; he will suddenly be destroyed-without remedy.

6.zh: 耶和华所恨恶的有六样，连他心所憎恶的共有七样：
6.en: There are six things the Lord hates, seven that are detestable to him:

6.zh: 就是高傲的眼，撒谎的舌，流无辜人血的手，
6.en: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

6.zh: 图谋恶计的心，飞跑行恶的脚，
6.en: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are quick to rush into evil,

6.zh: 吐谎言的假见证，并弟兄中布散纷争的人。
6.en: a false witness who pours out lies and a man who stirs up dissension among brothers.

6.zh: 我儿，要谨守你父亲的诫命；不可离弃你母亲的法则（或译：指教），
6.en: My son, keep your father's commands and do not forsake your mother's teaching.

6.zh: 要常系在你心上，挂在你项上。
6.en: Bind them upon your heart forever; fasten them around your neck.

6.zh: 你行走，他必引导你；你躺卧，他必保守你；你睡醒，他必与你谈论。
6.en: When you walk, they will guide you; when you sleep, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.

6.zh: 因为诫命是灯，法则（或译：指教）是光，训诲的责备是生命的道，
6.en: For these commands are a lamp, this teaching is a light, and the corrections of discipline are the way to life,

6.zh: 能保你远离恶妇，远离外女谄媚的舌头。
6.en: keeping you from the immoral woman, from the smooth tongue of the wayward wife.

6.zh: 你心中不要恋慕他的美色，也不要被他眼皮勾引。
6.en: Do not lust in your heart after her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes,

6.zh: 因为，妓女能使人只剩一块饼；淫妇猎取人宝贵的生命。
6.en: for the prostitute reduces you to a loaf of bread, and the adulteress preys upon your very life.

6.zh: 人若怀里搋火，衣服岂能不烧呢？
6.en: Can a man scoop fire into his lap without his clothes being burned?

6.zh: 人若在火炭上走，脚岂能不烫呢？
6.en: Can a man walk on hot coals without his feet being scorched?

6.zh: 亲近邻舍之妻的，也是如此；凡挨近他的，不免受罚。
6.en: So is he who sleeps with another man's wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.

6.zh: 贼因饥饿偷窃充饥，人不藐视他，
6.en: Men do not despise a thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger when he is starving.

6.zh: 若被找著，他必赔还七倍，必将家中所有的尽都偿还。
6.en: Yet if he is caught, he must pay sevenfold, though it costs him all the wealth of his house.

6.zh: 与妇人行淫的，便是无知；行这事的，必丧掉生命。
6.en: But a man who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.

6.zh: 他必受伤损，必被凌辱；他的羞耻不得涂抹。
6.en: Blows and disgrace are his lot, and his shame will never be wiped away;

6.zh: 因为人的嫉恨成了烈怒，报仇的时候决不留情。
6.en: for jealousy arouses a husband's fury, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.

6.zh: 甚么赎价，他都不顾；你虽送许多礼物，他也不肯干休。
6.en: He will not accept any compensation; he will refuse the bribe, however great it is.

7.zh: 我儿，你要遵守我的言语，将我的命令存记在心。
7.en: My son, keep my words and store upmy commands within you.

7.zh: 遵守我的命令就得存活；保守我的法则（或译：指教），好像保守眼中的瞳人，
7.en: Keep my commands and you will live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.

7.zh: 系在你指头上，刻在你心版上。
7.en: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.

7.zh: 对智慧说：你是我的姊妹，称呼聪明为你的亲人，
7.en: Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," and call understanding your kinsman;

7.zh: 他就保你远离淫妇，远离说谄媚话的外女。
7.en: they will keep you from the adulteress, from the wayward wife with her seductive words.

7.zh: 我曾在我房屋的窗户内，从我窗櫺之间往外观看：
7.en: At the window of my house I looked out through the lattice.

7.zh: 见愚蒙人内，少年人中，分明有一个无知的少年人，
7.en: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the young men, a youth who lacked judgment.

7.zh: 从街上经过，走近淫妇的巷口，直往通他家的路去，
7.en: He was going down the street near her corner, walking along in the direction of her house

7.zh: 在黄昏，或晚上，或半夜，或黑暗之中。
7.en: at twilight, as the day was fading, as the dark of night set in.

7.zh: 看哪，有一个妇人来迎接他，是妓女的打扮，有诡诈的心思。
7.en: Then out came a woman to meet him, dressed like a prostitute and with crafty intent.

7.zh: 这妇人喧嚷，不守约束，在家里停不住脚，
7.en: (She is loud and defiant, her feet never stay at home;

7.zh: 有时在街市上，有时在宽阔处，或在各巷口蹲伏，
7.en: now in the street, now in the squares, at every corner she lurks.)

7.zh: 拉住那少年人，与他亲嘴，脸无羞耻对他说：
7.en: She took hold of him and kissed him and with a brazen face she said:

7.zh: 平安祭在我这里，今日才还了我所许的愿。
7.en: "I have fellowship offerings at home; today I fulfilled my vows.

7.zh: 因此，我出来迎接你，恳切求见你的面，恰巧遇见了你。
7.en: So I came out to meet you; I looked for you and have found you!

7.zh: 我已经用绣花毯子和埃及线织的花纹布铺了我的床。
7.en: I have covered my bed with colored linens from Egypt.

7.zh: 我又用没药 、 沉香 、 桂皮薰了我的榻。
7.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.

7.zh: 你来，我们可以饱享爱情，直到早晨；我们可以彼此亲爱欢乐。
7.en: Come, let's drink deep of love till morning; let's enjoy ourselves with love!

7.zh: 因为我丈夫不在家，出门行远路；
7.en: My husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.

7.zh: 他手拿银囊，必到月望才回家。
7.en: He took his purse filled with money and will not be home till full moon."

7.zh: 淫妇用许多巧言诱他随从，用谄媚的嘴逼他同行。
7.en: With persuasive words she led him astray; she seduced him with her smooth talk.

7.zh: 少年人立刻跟随他，好像牛往宰杀之地，又像愚昧人带锁炼去受刑罚，
7.en: All at once he followed her like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer stepping into a noose

7.zh: 直等箭穿他的肝，如同雀鸟急入网罗，却不知是自丧己命。
7.en: till an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare, little knowing it will cost him his life.

7.zh: 众子啊，现在要听从我，留心听我口中的话。
7.en: Now then, my sons, listen to me; pay attention to what I say.

7.zh: 你的心不可偏向淫妇的道，不要入他的迷途。
7.en: Do not let your heart turn to her ways or stray into her paths.

7.zh: 因为，被他伤害仆倒的不少；被他杀戮的而且甚多。
7.en: Many are the victims she has brought down; her slain are a mighty throng.

7.zh: 他的家是在阴间之路，下到死亡之宫。
7.en: Her house is a highway to the grave, leading down to the chambers of death.

8.zh: 智慧岂不呼叫？聪明岂不发声？
8.en: Does not wisdom call out? Does notunderstanding raise her voice?

8.zh: 他在道旁高处的顶上，在十字路口站立，
8.en: On the heights along the way, where the paths meet, she takes her stand;

8.zh: 在城门旁，在城门口，在城门洞，大声说：
8.en: beside the gates leading into the city, at the entrances, she cries aloud:

8.zh: 众人哪，我呼叫你们，我向世人发声。
8.en: "To you, O men, I call out; I raise my voice to all mankind.

8.zh: 说：愚蒙人哪，你们要会悟灵明；愚昧人哪，你们当心里明白。
8.en: You who are simple, gain prudence; you who are foolish, gain understanding.

8.zh: 你们当听，因我要说极美的话；我张嘴要论正直的事。
8.en: Listen, for I have worthy things to say; I open my lips to speak what is right.

8.zh: 我的口要发出真理；我的嘴憎恶邪恶。
8.en: My mouth speaks what is true, for my lips detest wickedness.

8.zh: 我口中的言语都是公义，并无弯曲乖僻。
8.en: All the words of my mouth are just; none of them is crooked or perverse.

8.zh: 有聪明的，以为明显，得知识的，以为正直。
8.en: To the discerning all of them are right; they are faultless to those who have knowledge.

8.zh: 你们当受我的教训，不受白银；宁得知识，胜过黄金。
8.en: Choose my instruction instead of silver, knowledge rather than choice gold,

8.zh: 因为智慧比珍珠（或译：红宝石）更美；一切可喜爱的都不足与比较。
8.en: for wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire can compare with her.

8.zh: 我 ─ 智慧以灵明为居所，又寻得知识和谋略。
8.en: "I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.

8.zh: 敬畏耶和华在乎恨恶邪恶；那骄傲 、 狂妄，并恶道，以及乖谬的口，都为我所恨恶。
8.en: To fear the Lord is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil behavior and perverse speech.

8.zh: 我有谋略和真知识；我乃聪明，我有能力。
8.en: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have understanding and power.

8.zh: 帝王藉我坐国位；君王藉我定公平。
8.en: By me kings reign and rulers make laws that are just;

8.zh: 王子和首领，世上一切的审判官，都是藉我掌权。
8.en: by me princes govern, and all nobles who rule on earth.

8.zh: 爱我的，我也爱他；恳切寻求我的，必寻得见。
8.en: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.

8.zh: 丰富尊荣在我；恒久的财并公义也在我。
8.en: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and prosperity.

8.zh: 我的果实胜过黄金，强如精金；我的出产超乎高银。
8.en: My fruit is better than fine gold; what I yield surpasses choice silver.

8.zh: 我在公义的道上走，在公平的路中行，
8.en: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,

8.zh: 使爱我的，承受货财，并充满他们的府库。
8.en: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.

8.zh: 在耶和华造化的起头，在太初创造万物之先，就有了我。
8.en: "The Lord brought me forth as the first of his works, , before his deeds of old;

8.zh: 从亘古，从太初，未有世界以前，我已被立。
8.en: I was appointed from eternity, from the beginning, before the world began.

8.zh: 没有深渊，没有大水的泉源，我已生出。
8.en: When there were no oceans, I was given birth, when there were no springs abounding with water;

8.zh: 大山未曾奠定，小山未有之先，我已生出。
8.en: before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was given birth,

8.zh: 耶和华还没有创造大地和田野，并世上的土质，我已生出。
8.en: before he made the earth or its fields or any of the dust of the world.

8.zh: 他立高天，我在那里；他在渊面的周围，划出圆圈。
8.en: I was there when he set the heavens in place, when he marked out the horizon on the face of the deep,

8.zh: 上使穹苍坚硬，下使渊源稳固，
8.en: when he established the clouds above and fixed securely the fountains of the deep,

8.zh: 为沧海定出界限，使水不越过他的命令，立定大地的根基。
8.en: when he gave the sea its boundary so the waters would not overstep his command, and when he marked out the foundations of the earth.

8.zh: 那时，我在他那里为工师，日日为他所喜爱，常常在他面前踊跃，
8.en: Then I was the craftsman at his side. I was filled with delight day after day, rejoicing always in his presence,

8.zh: 踊跃在他为人预备可住之地，也喜悦住在世人之间。
8.en: rejoicing in his whole world and delighting in mankind.

8.zh: 众子啊，现在要听从我，因为谨守我道的，便为有福。
8.en: "Now then, my sons, listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways.

8.zh: 要听教训就得智慧，不可弃绝。
8.en: Listen to my instruction and be wise; do not ignore it.

8.zh: 听从我 、 日日在我门口仰望 、 在我门框旁边等候的，那人便为有福。
8.en: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at my doorway.

8.zh: 因为寻得我的，就寻得生命，也必蒙耶和华的恩惠。
8.en: For whoever finds me finds life and receives favor from the Lord .

8.zh: 得罪我的，却害了自己的性命；恨恶我的，都喜爱死亡。
8.en: But whoever fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death."

9.zh: 智慧建造房屋，凿成七根柱子，
9.en: Wisdom has built her house; she hashewn out its seven pillars.

9.zh: 宰杀牲畜，调和旨酒，设摆筵席；
9.en: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

9.zh: 打发使女出去，自己在城中至高处呼叫，
9.en: She has sent out her maids, and she calls from the highest point of the city.

9.zh: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！又对那无知的人说：
9.en: "Let all who are simple come in here!" she says to those who lack judgment.

9.zh: 你们来，吃我的饼，喝我调和的酒。
9.en: "Come, eat my food and drink the wine I have mixed.

9.zh: 你们愚蒙人，要舍弃愚蒙，就得存活，并要走光明的道。
9.en: Leave your simple ways and you will live; walk in the way of understanding.

9.zh: 指斥亵慢人的，必受辱骂；责备恶人的，必被玷污。
9.en: "Whoever corrects a mocker invites insult; whoever rebukes a wicked man incurs abuse.

9.zh: 不要责备亵慢人，恐怕他恨你；要责备智慧人，他必爱你。
9.en: Do not rebuke a mocker or he will hate you; rebuke a wise man and he will love you.

9.zh: 教导智慧人，他就越发有智慧；指示义人，他就增长学问。
9.en: Instruct a wise man and he will be wiser still; teach a righteous man and he will add to his learning.

9.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端；认识至圣者便是聪明。
9.en: "The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

9.zh: 你藉著我，日子必增多，年岁也必加添。
9.en: For through me your days will be many, and years will be added to your life.

9.zh: 你若有智慧，是与自己有益；你若亵慢，就必独自担当。
9.en: If you are wise, your wisdom will reward you; if you are a mocker, you alone will suffer."

9.zh: 愚昧的妇人喧嚷；他是愚蒙，一无所知。
9.en: The woman Folly is loud; she is undisciplined and without knowledge.

9.zh: 他坐在自己的家门口，坐在城中高处的座位上，
9.en: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest point of the city,

9.zh: 呼叫过路的，就是直行其道的人，
9.en: calling out to those who pass by, who go straight on their way.

9.zh: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！又对那无知的人说：
9.en: "Let all who are simple come in here!" she says to those who lack judgment.

9.zh: 偷来的水是甜的，暗吃的饼是好的。
9.en: "Stolen water is sweet; food eaten in secret is delicious!"

9.zh: 人却不知有阴魂在他那里；他的客在阴间的深处。
9.en: But little do they know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of the grave.

10.zh: 所罗门的箴言：智慧之子使父亲欢乐；愚昧之子叫母亲担忧。
10.en: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son grief to his mother.

10.zh: 不义之财毫无益处；惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。
10.en: Ill-gotten treasures are of no value, but righteousness delivers from death.

10.zh: 耶和华不使义人受饥饿；恶人所欲的，他必推开。
10.en: The Lord does not let the righteous go hungry but he thwarts the craving of the wicked.

10.zh: 手懒的，要受贫穷；手勤的，却要富足。
10.en: Lazy hands make a man poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.

10.zh: 夏天聚敛的，是智慧之子；收割时沉睡的，是贻羞之子。
10.en: He who gathers crops in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.

10.zh: 福祉临到义人的头；强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。
10.en: Blessings crown the head of the righteous, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.

10.zh: 义人的纪念被称赞；恶人的名字必朽烂。
10.en: The memory of the righteous will be a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.

10.zh: 心中智慧的，必受命令；口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。
10.en: The wise in heart accept commands, but a chattering fool comes to ruin.

10.zh: 行正直路的，步步安稳；走弯曲道的，必致败露。
10.en: The man of integrity walks securely, but he who takes crooked paths will be found out.

10.zh: 以眼传神的，使人忧患；口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。
10.en: He who winks maliciously causes grief, and a chattering fool comes to ruin.

10.zh: 义人的口是生命的泉源；强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。
10.en: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.

10.zh: 恨能挑启争端；爱能遮掩一切过错。
10.en: Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers over all wrongs.

10.zh: 明哲人嘴里有智慧；无知人背上受刑杖。
10.en: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment.

10.zh: 智慧人积存知识；愚妄人的口速致败坏。
10.en: Wise men store up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool invites ruin.

10.zh: 富户的财物是他的坚城；穷人的贫乏是他的败坏。
10.en: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.

10.zh: 义人的勤劳致生；恶人的进项致死（死：原文是罪）。
10.en: The wages of the righteous bring them life, but the income of the wicked brings them punishment.

10.zh: 谨守训诲的，乃在生命的道上；违弃责备的，便失迷了路。
10.en: He who heeds discipline shows the way to life, but whoever ignores correction leads others astray.

10.zh: 隐藏怨恨的，有说谎的嘴；口出谗谤的，是愚妄的人。
10.en: He who conceals his hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.

10.zh: 多言多语难免有过；禁止嘴唇是有智慧。
10.en: When words are many, sin is not absent, but he who holds his tongue is wise.

10.zh: 义人的舌乃似高银；恶人的心所值无几。
10.en: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked is of little value.

10.zh: 义人的口教养多人；愚昧人因无知而死亡。
10.en: The lips of the righteous nourish many, but fools die for lack of judgment.

10.zh: 耶和华所赐的福使人富足，并不加上忧虑。
10.en: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

10.zh: 愚妄人以行恶为戏耍；明哲人却以智慧为乐。
10.en: A fool finds pleasure in evil conduct, but a man of understanding delights in wisdom.

10.zh: 恶人所怕的，必临到他；义人所愿的，必蒙应允。
10.en: What the wicked dreads will overtake him; what the righteous desire will be granted.

10.zh: 暴风一过，恶人归于无有；义人的根基却是永久。
10.en: When the storm has swept by, the wicked are gone, but the righteous stand firm forever.

10.zh: 懒惰人叫差他的人如醋倒牙，如烟薰目。
10.en: As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is a sluggard to those who send him.

10.zh: 敬畏耶和华使人日子加多；但恶人的年岁必被减少。
10.en: The fear of the Lord adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.

10.zh: 义人的盼望必得喜乐；恶人的指望必致灭没。
10.en: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hopes of the wicked come to nothing.

10.zh: 耶和华的道是正直人的保障，却成了作孽人的败坏。
10.en: The way of the Lord is a refuge for the righteous, but it is the ruin of those who do evil.

10.zh: 义人永不挪移；恶人不得住在地上。
10.en: The righteous will never be uprooted, but the wicked will not remain in the land.

10.zh: 义人的口滋生智慧；乖谬的舌必被割断。
10.en: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.

10.zh: 义人的嘴能令人喜悦；恶人的口说乖谬的话。
10.en: The lips of the righteous know what is fitting, but the mouth of the wicked only what is perverse.

11.zh: 诡诈的天平为耶和华所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。
11.en: The Lord abhors dishonest scales,but accurate weights are his delight.

11.zh: 骄傲来，羞耻也来；谦逊人却有智慧。
11.en: When pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with humility comes wisdom.

11.zh: 正直人的纯正必引导自己；奸诈人的乖僻必毁灭自己。
11.en: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the unfaithful are destroyed by their duplicity.

11.zh: 发怒的日子资财无益；惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。
11.en: Wealth is worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

11.zh: 完全人的义必指引他的路；但恶人必因自己的恶跌倒。
11.en: The righteousness of the blameless makes a straight way for them, but the wicked are brought down by their own wickedness.

11.zh: 正直人的义必拯救自己；奸诈人必陷在自己的罪孽中。
11.en: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the unfaithful are trapped by evil desires.

11.zh: 恶人一死，他的指望必灭绝；罪人的盼望也必灭没。
11.en: When a wicked man dies, his hope perishes; all he expected from his power comes to nothing.

11.zh: 义人得脱离患难，有恶人来代替他。
11.en: The righteous man is rescued from trouble, and it comes on the wicked instead.

11.zh: 不虔敬的人用口败坏邻舍；义人却因知识得救。
11.en: With his mouth the godless destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous escape.

11.zh: 义人享福，合城喜乐；恶人灭亡，人都欢呼。
11.en: When the righteous prosper, the city rejoices; when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.

11.zh: 城因正直人祝福便高举，却因邪恶人的口就倾覆。
11.en: Through the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is destroyed.

11.zh: 藐视邻舍的，毫无智慧；明哲人却静默不言。
11.en: A man who lacks judgment derides his neighbor, but a man of understanding holds his tongue.

11.zh: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事；心中诚实的，遮隐事情。
11.en: A gossip betrays a confidence, but a trustworthy man keeps a secret.

11.zh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。
11.en: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but many advisers make victory sure.

11.zh: 为外人作保的，必受亏损；恨恶击掌的，却得安稳。
11.en: He who puts up security for another will surely suffer, but whoever refuses to strike hands in pledge is safe.

11.zh: 恩德的妇女得尊荣；强暴的男子得资财。
11.en: A kindhearted woman gains respect, but ruthless men gain only wealth.

11.zh: 仁慈的人善待自己；残忍的人扰害己身。
11.en: A kind man benefits himself, but a cruel man brings trouble on himself.

11.zh: 恶人经营，得虚浮的工价；撒义种的，得实在的果效。
11.en: The wicked man earns deceptive wages, but he who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

11.zh: 恒心为义的，必得生命；追求邪恶的，必致死亡。
11.en: The truly righteous man attains life, but he who pursues evil goes to his death.

11.zh: 心中乖僻的，为耶和华所憎恶；行事完全的，为他所喜悦。
11.en: The Lord detests men of perverse heart but he delights in those whose ways are blameless.

11.zh: 恶人虽然连手，必不免受罚；义人的后裔必得拯救。
11.en: Be sure of this: The wicked will not go unpunished, but those who are righteous will go free.

11.zh: 妇女美貌而无见识，如同金环带在猪鼻上。
11.en: Like a gold ring in a pig's snout is a beautiful woman who shows no discretion.

11.zh: 义人的心愿尽得好处；恶人的指望致干忿怒。
11.en: The desire of the righteous ends only in good, but the hope of the wicked only in wrath.

11.zh: 有施散的，却更增添；有吝惜过度的，反致穷乏。
11.en: One man gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty.

11.zh: 好施舍的，必得丰裕；滋润人的，必得滋润。
11.en: A generous man will prosper; he who refreshes others will himself be refreshed.

11.zh: 屯粮不卖的，民必咒诅他；情愿出卖的，人必为他祝福。
11.en: People curse the man who hoards grain, but blessing crowns him who is willing to sell.

11.zh: 恳切求善的，就求得恩惠；惟独求恶的，恶必临到他身。
11.en: He who seeks good finds goodwill, but evil comes to him who searches for it.

11.zh: 倚仗自己财物的，必跌倒；义人必发旺，如青叶。
11.en: Whoever trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like a green leaf.

11.zh: 扰害己家的，必承受清风；愚昧人必作慧心人的仆人。
11.en: He who brings trouble on his family will inherit only wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise.

11.zh: 义人所结的果子就是生命树；有智慧的，必能得人。
11.en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.

11.zh: 看哪，义人在世尚且受报，何况恶人和罪人呢？
11.en: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!

12.zh: 喜爱管教的，就是喜爱知识；恨恶责备的，却是畜类。
12.en: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.

12.zh: 善人必蒙耶和华的恩惠；设诡计的人，耶和华必定他的罪。
12.en: A good man obtains favor from the Lord , but the Lord condemns a crafty man.

12.zh: 人靠恶行不能坚立；义人的根必不动摇。
12.en: A man cannot be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.

12.zh: 才德的妇人是丈夫的冠冕；贻羞的妇人如同朽烂在他丈夫的骨中。
12.en: A wife of noble character is her husband's crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.

12.zh: 义人的思念是公平；恶人的计谋是诡诈。
12.en: The plans of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

12.zh: 恶人的言论是埋伏流人的血；正直人的口必拯救人。
12.en: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

12.zh: 恶人倾覆，归于无有；义人的家必站得住。
12.en: Wicked men are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous stands firm.

12.zh: 人必按自己的智慧被称赞；心中乖谬的，必被藐视。
12.en: A man is praised according to his wisdom, but men with warped minds are despised.

12.zh: 被人轻贱，却有仆人，强如自尊，缺少食物。
12.en: Better to be a nobody and yet have a servant than pretend to be somebody and have no food.

12.zh: 义人顾惜他牲畜的命；恶人的怜悯也是残忍。
12.en: A righteous man cares for the needs of his animal, but the kindest acts of the wicked are cruel.

12.zh: 耕种自己田地的，必得饱食；追随虚浮的，却是无知。
12.en: He who works his land will have abundant food, but he who chases fantasies lacks judgment.

12.zh: 恶人想得坏人的网罗；义人的根得以结实。
12.en: The wicked desire the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

12.zh: 恶人嘴中的过错是自己的网罗；但义人必脱离患难。
12.en: An evil man is trapped by his sinful talk, but a righteous man escapes trouble.

12.zh: 人因口所结的果子，必饱得美福；人手所做的，必为自己的报应。
12.en: From the fruit of his lips a man is filled with good things as surely as the work of his hands rewards him.

12.zh: 愚妄人所行的，在自己眼中看为正直；惟智慧人肯听人的劝教。
12.en: The way of a fool seems right to him, but a wise man listens to advice.

12.zh: 愚妄人的恼怒立时显露；通达人能忍辱藏羞。
12.en: A fool shows his annoyance at once, but a prudent man overlooks an insult.

12.zh: 说出真话的，显明公义；作假见证的，显出诡诈。
12.en: A truthful witness gives honest testimony, but a false witness tells lies.

12.zh: 说话浮躁的，如刀刺人；智慧人的舌头却为医人的良药。
12.en: Reckless words pierce like a sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.

12.zh: 口吐真言，永远坚立；舌说谎话，只存片时。
12.en: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.

12.zh: 图谋恶事的，心存诡诈；劝人和睦的，便得喜乐。
12.en: There is deceit in the hearts of those who plot evil, but joy for those who promote peace.

12.zh: 义人不遭灾害；恶人满受祸患。
12.en: No harm befalls the righteous, but the wicked have their fill of trouble.

12.zh: 说谎言的嘴为耶和华所憎恶；行事诚实的，为他所喜悦。
12.en: The Lord detests lying lips, but he delights in men who are truthful.

12.zh: 通达人隐藏知识；愚昧人的心彰显愚昧。
12.en: A prudent man keeps his knowledge to himself, but the heart of fools blurts out folly.

12.zh: 殷勤人的手必掌权；懒惰的人必服苦。
12.en: Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

12.zh: 人心忧虑，屈而不伸；一句良言，使心欢乐。
12.en: An anxious heart weighs a man down, but a kind word cheers him up.

12.zh: 义人引导他的邻舍；恶人的道叫人失迷。
12.en: A righteous man is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

12.zh: 懒惰的人不烤打猎所得的；殷勤的人却得宝贵的财物。
12.en: The lazy man does not roast his game, but the diligent man prizes his possessions.

12.zh: 在公义的道上有生命；其路之中并无死亡。
12.en: In the way of righteousness there is life; along that path is immortality.

13.zh: 智慧子听父亲的教训；亵慢人不听责备。
13.en: A wise son heeds his father's instruction, but a mocker does not listen to rebuke.

13.zh: 人因口所结的果子，必享美福；奸诈人必遭强暴。
13.en: From the fruit of his lips a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful have a craving for violence.

13.zh: 谨守口的，得保生命；大张嘴的，必致败亡。
13.en: He who guards his lips guards his life, but he who speaks rashly will come to ruin.

13.zh: 懒惰人羡慕，却无所得；殷勤人必得丰裕。
13.en: The sluggard craves and gets nothing, but the desires of the diligent are fully satisfied.

13.zh: 义人恨恶谎言；恶人有臭名，且致惭愧。
13.en: The righteous hate what is false, but the wicked bring shame and disgrace.

13.zh: 行为正直的，有公义保守；犯罪的，被邪恶倾覆。
13.en: Righteousness guards the man of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

13.zh: 假作富足的，却一无所有；装作穷乏的，却广有财物。
13.en: One man pretends to be rich, yet has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.

13.zh: 人的资财是他生命的赎价；穷乏人却听不见威吓的话。
13.en: A man's riches may ransom his life, but a poor man hears no threat.

13.zh: 义人的光明亮（原文是欢喜）；恶人的灯要熄灭 . 。
13.en: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

13.zh: 骄傲只启争竞；听劝言的，却有智慧。
13.en: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is found in those who take advice.

13.zh: 不劳而得之财必然消耗；勤劳积蓄的，必见加增。
13.en: Dishonest money dwindles away, but he who gathers money little by little makes it grow.

13.zh: 所盼望的迟延未得，令人心忧；所愿意的临到，却是生命树。
13.en: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a longing fulfilled is a tree of life.

13.zh: 藐视训言的，自取灭亡；敬畏诫命的，必得善报。
13.en: He who scorns instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command is rewarded.

13.zh: 智慧人的法则（或译：指教）是生命的泉源，可以使人离开死亡的网罗。
13.en: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.

13.zh: 美好的聪明使人蒙恩；奸诈人的道路崎岖难行。
13.en: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

13.zh: 凡通达人都凭知识行事；愚昧人张扬自己的愚昧。
13.en: Every prudent man acts out of knowledge, but a fool exposes his folly.

13.zh: 奸恶的使者必陷在祸患里；忠信的使臣乃医人的良药。
13.en: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy brings healing.

13.zh: 弃绝管教的，必致贫受辱；领受责备的，必得尊荣。
13.en: He who ignores discipline comes to poverty and shame, but whoever heeds correction is honored.

13.zh: 所欲的成就，心觉甘甜；远离恶事，为愚昧人所憎恶。
13.en: A longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

13.zh: 与智慧人同行的，必得智慧；和愚昧人作伴的，必受亏损。
13.en: He who walks with the wise grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

13.zh: 祸患追赶罪人；义人必得善报。
13.en: Misfortune pursues the sinner, but prosperity is the reward of the righteous.

13.zh: 善人给子孙遗留产业；罪人为义人积存资财。
13.en: A good man leaves an inheritance for his children's children, but a sinner's wealth is stored up for the righteous.

13.zh: 穷人耕种多得粮食，但因不义，有消灭的。
13.en: A poor man's field may produce abundant food, but injustice sweeps it away.

13.zh: 不忍用杖打儿子的，是恨恶他；疼爱儿子的，随时管教。
13.en: He who spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him is careful to discipline him.

13.zh: 义人吃得饱足；恶人肚腹缺粮。
13.en: The righteous eat to their hearts' content, but the stomach of the wicked goes hungry.

14.zh: 智慧妇人建立家室；愚妄妇人亲手拆毁。
14.en: The wise woman builds her house, but with her own hands the foolish one tears hers down.

14.zh: 行动正直的，敬畏耶和华；行事乖僻的，却藐视他。
14.en: He whose walk is upright fears the Lord , but he whose ways are devious despises him.

14.zh: 愚妄人口中骄傲，如杖责打己身；智慧人的嘴必保守自己。
14.en: A fool's talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

14.zh: 家里无牛，槽头干净；土产加多乃凭牛力。
14.en: Where there are no oxen, the manger is empty, but from the strength of an ox comes an abundant harvest.

14.zh: 诚实见证人不说谎话；假见证人吐出谎言。
14.en: A truthful witness does not deceive, but a false witness pours out lies.

14.zh: 亵慢人寻智慧，却寻不著；聪明人易得知识。
14.en: The mocker seeks wisdom and finds none, but knowledge comes easily to the discerning.

14.zh: 到愚昧人面前，不见他嘴中有知识。
14.en: Stay away from a foolish man, for you will not find knowledge on his lips.

14.zh: 通达人的智慧在乎明白己道；愚昧人的愚妄乃是诡诈（或译：自叹）。
14.en: The wisdom of the prudent is to give thought to their ways, but the folly of fools is deception.

14.zh: 愚妄人犯罪，以为戏耍（或译：赎愆祭愚弄愚妄人）；正直人互相喜悦。
14.en: Fools mock at making amends for sin, but goodwill is found among the upright.

14.zh: 心中的苦楚，自己知道；心里的喜乐，外人无干。
14.en: Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no one else can share its joy.

14.zh: 奸恶人的房屋必倾倒；正直人的帐棚必兴盛。
14.en: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

14.zh: 有一条路，人以为正，至终成为死亡之路。
14.en: There is a way that seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

14.zh: 人在喜笑中，心也忧愁；快乐至极就生愁苦。
14.en: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and joy may end in grief.

14.zh: 心中背道的，必满得自己的结果；善人必从自己的行为得以知足。
14.en: The faithless will be fully repaid for their ways, and the good man rewarded for his.

14.zh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。
14.en: A simple man believes anything, but a prudent man gives thought to his steps.

14.zh: 智慧人惧怕，就远离恶事；愚妄人却狂傲自恃。
14.en: A wise man fears the Lord and shuns evil, but a fool is hotheaded and reckless.

14.zh: 轻易发怒的，行事愚妄；设立诡计的，被人恨恶。
14.en: A quick-tempered man does foolish things, and a crafty man is hated.

14.zh: 愚蒙人得愚昧为产业；通达人得知识为冠冕。
14.en: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

14.zh: 坏人俯伏在善人面前；恶人俯伏在义人门口。
14.en: Evil men will bow down in the presence of the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

14.zh: 贫穷人连邻舍也恨他；富足人朋友最多。
14.en: The poor are shunned even by their neighbors, but the rich have many friends.

14.zh: 藐视邻舍的，这人有罪；怜悯贫穷的，这人有福。
14.en: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who is kind to the needy.

14.zh: 谋恶的，岂非走入迷途么？谋善的，必得慈爱和诚实。
14.en: Do not those who plot evil go astray? But those who plan what is good find love and faithfulness.

14.zh: 诸般勤劳都有益处；嘴上多言乃致穷乏。
14.en: All hard work brings a profit, but mere talk leads only to poverty.

14.zh: 智慧人的财为自己的冠冕；愚妄人的愚昧终是愚昧。
14.en: The wealth of the wise is their crown, but the folly of fools yields folly.

14.zh: 作真见证的，救人性命；吐出谎言的，施行诡诈。
14.en: A truthful witness saves lives, but a false witness is deceitful.

14.zh: 敬畏耶和华的，大有倚靠；他的儿女也有避难所。
14.en: He who fears the Lord has a secure fortress, and for his children it will be a refuge.

14.zh: 敬畏耶和华就是生命的泉源，可以使人离开死亡的网罗。
14.en: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.

14.zh: 帝王荣耀在乎民多；君王衰败在乎民少。
14.en: A large population is a king's glory, but without subjects a prince is ruined.

14.zh: 不轻易发怒的，大有聪明；性情暴躁的，大显愚妄。
14.en: A patient man has great understanding, but a quick-tempered man displays folly.

14.zh: 心中安静是肉体的生命；嫉妒是骨中的朽烂。
14.en: A heart at peace gives life to the body, but envy rots the bones.

14.zh: 欺压贫寒的，是辱没造他的主；怜悯穷乏的，乃是尊敬主。
14.en: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors God.

14.zh: 恶人在所行的恶上必被推倒；义人临死，有所投靠。
14.en: When calamity comes, the wicked are brought down, but even in death the righteous have a refuge.

14.zh: 智慧存在聪明人心中；愚昧人心里所存的，显而易见。
14.en: Wisdom reposes in the heart of the discerning and even among fools she lets herself be known.

14.zh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。
14.en: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

14.zh: 智慧的臣子蒙王恩惠；贻羞的仆人遭其震怒。
14.en: A king delights in a wise servant, but a shameful servant incurs his wrath.

15.zh: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言语暴戾，触动怒气。
15.en: A gentle answer turns away wrath,but a harsh word stirs up anger.

15.zh: 智慧人的舌善发知识；愚昧人的口吐出愚昧。
15.en: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool gushes folly.

15.zh: 耶和华的眼目无处不在；恶人善人，他都鉴察。
15.en: The eyes of the Lord are everywhere, keeping watch on the wicked and the good.

15.zh: 温良的舌是生命树；乖谬的嘴使人心碎。
15.en: The tongue that brings healing is a tree of life, but a deceitful tongue crushes the spirit.

15.zh: 愚妄人藐视父亲的管教；领受责备的，得著见识。
15.en: A fool spurns his father's discipline, but whoever heeds correction shows prudence.

15.zh: 义人家中多有财宝；恶人得利反受扰害。
15.en: The house of the righteous contains great treasure, but the income of the wicked brings them trouble.

15.zh: 智慧人的嘴播扬知识；愚昧人的心并不如此。
15.en: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so the hearts of fools.

15.zh: 恶人献祭，为耶和华所憎恶；正直人祈祷，为他所喜悦。
15.en: The Lord detests the sacrifice of the wicked, but the prayer of the upright pleases him.

15.zh: 恶人的道路，为耶和华所憎恶；追求公义的，为他所喜爱。
15.en: The Lord detests the way of the wicked but he loves those who pursue righteousness.

15.zh: 舍弃正路的，必受严刑；恨恶责备的，必致死亡。
15.en: Stern discipline awaits him who leaves the path; he who hates correction will die.

15.zh: 阴间和灭亡尚在耶和华眼前，何况世人的心呢？
15.en: Death and Destruction lie open before the Lord - how much more the hearts of men!

15.zh: 亵慢人不爱受责备；他也不就近智慧人。
15.en: A mocker resents correction; he will not consult the wise.

15.zh: 心中喜乐，面带笑容；心里忧愁，灵被损伤。
15.en: A happy heart makes the face cheerful, but heartache crushes the spirit.

15.zh: 聪明人心求知识；愚昧人口吃愚昧。
15.en: The discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.

15.zh: 困苦人的日子都是愁苦；心中欢畅的，常享丰筵。
15.en: All the days of the oppressed are wretched, but the cheerful heart has a continual feast.

15.zh: 少有财宝，敬畏耶和华，强如多有财宝，烦乱不安。
15.en: Better a little with the fear of the Lord than great wealth with turmoil.

15.zh: 吃素菜，彼此相爱，强如吃肥牛，彼此相恨。
15.en: Better a meal of vegetables where there is love than a fattened calf with hatred.

15.zh: 暴怒的人挑启争端；忍怒的人止息纷争。
15.en: A hot-tempered man stirs up dissension, but a patient man calms a quarrel.

15.zh: 懒惰人的道像荆棘的篱笆；正直人的路是平坦的大道。
15.en: The way of the sluggard is blocked with thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.

15.zh: 智慧子使父亲喜乐；愚昧人藐视母亲。
15.en: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.

15.zh: 无知的人以愚妄为乐；聪明的人按正直而行。
15.en: Folly delights a man who lacks judgment, but a man of understanding keeps a straight course.

15.zh: 不先商议，所谋无效；谋士众多，所谋乃成。
15.en: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.

15.zh: 口善应对，自觉喜乐；话合其时，何等美好。
15.en: A man finds joy in giving an apt reply-and how good is a timely word!

15.zh: 智慧人从生命的道上升，使他远离在下的阴间。
15.en: The path of life leads upward for the wise to keep him from going down to the grave.

15.zh: 耶和华必拆毁骄傲人的家，却要立定寡妇的地界。
15.en: The Lord tears down the proud man's house but he keeps the widow's boundaries intact.

15.zh: 恶谋为耶和华所憎恶；良言乃为纯净。
15.en: The Lord detests the thoughts of the wicked, but those of the pure are pleasing to him.

15.zh: 贪恋财利的，扰害己家；恨恶贿赂的，必得存活。
15.en: A greedy man brings trouble to his family, but he who hates bribes will live.

15.zh: 义人的心，思量如何回答；恶人的口吐出恶言。
15.en: The heart of the righteous weighs its answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes evil.

15.zh: 耶和华远离恶人，却听义人的祷告。
15.en: The Lord is far from the wicked but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

15.zh: 眼有光，使心喜乐；好信息，使骨滋润。
15.en: A cheerful look brings joy to the heart, and good news gives health to the bones.

15.zh: 听从生命责备的，必常在智慧人中。
15.en: He who listens to a life-giving rebuke will be at home among the wise.

15.zh: 弃绝管教的，轻看自己的生命；听从责备的，却得智慧。
15.en: He who ignores discipline despises himself, but whoever heeds correction gains understanding.

15.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的训诲；尊荣以前，必有谦卑。
15.en: The fear of the Lord teaches a man wisdom, and humility comes before honor.

16.zh: 心中的谋算在乎人；舌头的应对由于耶和华。
16.en: To man belong the plans of the heart, but from the Lord comes the reply of the tongue.

16.zh: 人一切所行的，在自己眼中看为清洁；惟有耶和华衡量人心。
16.en: All a man's ways seem innocent to him, but motives are weighed by the Lord .

16.zh: 你所做的，要交托耶和华，你所谋的，就必成立。
16.en: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and your plans will succeed.

16.zh: 耶和华所造的，各适其用；就是恶人也为祸患的日子所造。
16.en: The Lord works out everything for his own ends- even the wicked for a day of disaster.

16.zh: 凡心里骄傲的，为耶和华所憎恶；虽然连手，他必不免受罚。
16.en: The Lord detests all the proud of heart. Be sure of this: They will not go unpunished.

16.zh: 因怜悯诚实，罪孽得赎；敬畏耶和华的，远离恶事。
16.en: Through love and faithfulness sin is atoned for; through the fear of the Lord a man avoids evil.

16.zh: 人所行的，若蒙耶和华喜悦，耶和华也使他的仇敌与他和好。
16.en: When a man's ways are pleasing to the Lord , he makes even his enemies live at peace with him.

16.zh: 多有财利，行事不义，不如少有财利，行事公义。
16.en: Better a little with righteousness than much gain with injustice.

16.zh: 人心筹算自己的道路；惟耶和华指引他的脚步。
16.en: In his heart a man plans his course, but the Lord determines his steps.

16.zh: 王的嘴中有神语，审判之时，他的口必不差错。
16.en: The lips of a king speak as an oracle, and his mouth should not betray justice.

16.zh: 公道的天平和秤都属耶和华；囊中一切法码都为他所定。
16.en: Honest scales and balances are from the Lord ; all the weights in the bag are of his making.

16.zh: 作恶，为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。
16.en: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.

16.zh: 公义的嘴为王所喜悦；说正直话的，为王所喜爱。
16.en: Kings take pleasure in honest lips; they value a man who speaks the truth.

16.zh: 王的震怒如杀人的使者；但智慧人能止息王怒。
16.en: A king's wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will appease it.

16.zh: 王的脸光使人有生命；王的恩典好像春云时雨。
16.en: When a king's face brightens, it means life; his favor is like a rain cloud in spring.

16.zh: 得智慧胜似得金子；选聪明强如选银子。
16.en: How much better to get wisdom than gold, to choose understanding rather than silver!

16.zh: 正直人的道是远离恶事；谨守己路的，是保全性命。
16.en: The highway of the upright avoids evil; he who guards his way guards his life.

16.zh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。
16.en: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.

16.zh: 心里谦卑与穷乏人来往，强如将掳物与骄傲人同分。
16.en: Better to be lowly in spirit and among the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.

16.zh: 谨守训言的，必得好处；倚靠耶和华的，便为有福。
16.en: Whoever gives heed to instruction prospers, and blessed is he who trusts in the Lord .

16.zh: 心中有智慧，必称为通达人；嘴中的甜言，加增人的学问。
16.en: The wise in heart are called discerning, and pleasant words promote instruction.

16.zh: 人有智慧就有生命的泉源；愚昧人必被愚昧惩治。
16.en: Understanding is a fountain of life to those who have it, but folly brings punishment to fools.

16.zh: 智慧人的心教训他的口，又使他的嘴增长学问。
16.en: A wise man's heart guides his mouth, and his lips promote instruction.

16.zh: 良言如同蜂房，使心觉甘甜，使骨得医治。
16.en: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.

16.zh: 有一条路，人以为正，至终成为死亡之路。
16.en: There is a way that seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

16.zh: 劳力人的胃口使他劳力，因为他的口腹催逼他。
16.en: The laborer's appetite works for him; his hunger drives him on.

16.zh: 匪徒图谋奸恶，嘴上彷佛有烧焦的火。
16.en: A scoundrel plots evil, and his speech is like a scorching fire.

16.zh: 乖僻人播散纷争；传舌的，离间密友。
16.en: A perverse man stirs up dissension, and a gossip separates close friends.

16.zh: 强暴人诱惑邻舍，领他走不善之道。
16.en: A violent man entices his neighbor and leads him down a path that is not good.

16.zh: 眼目紧合的，图谋乖僻；嘴唇紧闭的，成就邪恶。
16.en: He who winks with his eye is plotting perversity; he who purses his lips is bent on evil.

16.zh: 白发是荣耀的冠冕，在公义的道上必能得著。
16.en: Gray hair is a crown of splendor; it is attained by a righteous life.

16.zh: 不轻易发怒的，胜过勇士；治服己心的，强如取城。
16.en: Better a patient man than a warrior, a man who controls his temper than one who takes a city.

16.zh: 签放在怀里，定事由耶和华。
16.en: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the Lord .

17.zh: 设筵满屋，大家相争，不如有块干饼，大家相安。
17.en: Better a dry crust with peace and quiet than a house full of feasting, with strife.

17.zh: 仆人办事聪明，必管辖贻羞之子，又在众子中同分产业。
17.en: A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son, and will share the inheritance as one of the brothers.

17.zh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金；惟有耶和华熬炼人心。
17.en: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but the Lord tests the heart.

17.zh: 行恶的，留心听奸诈之言；说谎的，侧耳听邪恶之语。
17.en: A wicked man listens to evil lips; a liar pays attention to a malicious tongue.

17.zh: 戏笑穷人的，是辱没造他的主；幸灾乐祸的，必不免受罚。
17.en: He who mocks the poor shows contempt for their Maker; whoever gloats over disaster will not go unpunished.

17.zh: 子孙为老人的冠冕；父亲是儿女的荣耀。
17.en: Children's children are a crown to the aged, and parents are the pride of their children.

17.zh: 愚顽人说美言本不相宜，何况君王说谎话呢？
17.en: Arrogant lips are unsuited to a fool-how much worse lying lips to a ruler!

17.zh: 贿赂在馈送的人眼中看为宝玉，随处运动都得顺利。
17.en: A bribe is a charm to the one who gives it; wherever he turns, he succeeds.

17.zh: 遮掩人过的，寻求人爱；屡次挑错的，离间密友。
17.en: He who covers over an offense promotes love, but whoever repeats the matter separates close friends.

17.zh: 一句责备话深入聪明人的心，强如责打愚昧人一百下。
17.en: A rebuke impresses a man of discernment more than a hundred lashes a fool.

17.zh: 恶人只寻背叛，所以必有严厉的使者奉差攻击他。
17.en: An evil man is bent only on rebellion; a merciless official will be sent against him.

17.zh: 宁可遇见丢崽子的母熊，不可遇见正行愚妄的愚昧人。
17.en: Better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool in his folly.

17.zh: 以恶报善的，祸患必不离他的家。
17.en: If a man pays back evil for good, evil will never leave his house.

17.zh: 纷争的起头如水放开，所以，在争闹之先必当止息争竞。
17.en: Starting a quarrel is like breaching a dam; so drop the matter before a dispute breaks out.

17.zh: 定恶人为义的，定义人为恶的，这都为耶和华所憎恶。
17.en: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the innocent- the Lord detests them both.

17.zh: 愚昧人既无聪明，为何手拿价银买智慧呢？
17.en: Of what use is money in the hand of a fool, since he has no desire to get wisdom?

17.zh: 朋友乃时常亲爱，弟兄为患难而生。
17.en: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

17.zh: 在邻舍面前击掌作保乃是无知的人。
17.en: A man lacking in judgment strikes hands in pledge and puts up security for his neighbor.

17.zh: 喜爱争竞的，是喜爱过犯；高立家门的，乃自取败坏。
17.en: He who loves a quarrel loves sin; he who builds a high gate invites destruction.

17.zh: 心存邪僻的，寻不著好处；舌弄是非的，陷在祸患中。
17.en: A man of perverse heart does not prosper; he whose tongue is deceitful falls into trouble.

17.zh: 生愚昧子的，必自愁苦；愚顽人的父毫无喜乐。
17.en: To have a fool for a son brings grief; there is no joy for the father of a fool.

17.zh: 喜乐的心乃是良药；忧伤的灵使骨枯干。
17.en: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

17.zh: 恶人暗中受贿赂，为要颠倒判断。
17.en: A wicked man accepts a bribe in secret to pervert the course of justice.

17.zh: 明哲人眼前有智慧；愚昧人眼望地极。
17.en: A discerning man keeps wisdom in view, but a fool's eyes wander to the ends of the earth.

17.zh: 愚昧子使父亲愁烦，使母亲忧苦。
17.en: A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to the one who bore him.

17.zh: 刑罚义人为不善；责打君子为不义。
17.en: It is not good to punish an innocent man, or to flog officials for their integrity.

17.zh: 寡少言语的，有知识；性情温良的，有聪明。
17.en: A man of knowledge uses words with restraint, and a man of understanding is even-tempered.

17.zh: 愚昧人若静默不言也可算为智慧；闭口不说也可算为聪明。
17.en: Even a fool is thought wise if he keeps silent, and discerning if he holds his tongue.

18.zh: 与众寡合的，独自寻求心愿，并恼恨一切真智慧。
18.en: An unfriendly man pursues selfishends; he defies all sound judgment.

18.zh: 愚昧人不喜爱明哲，只喜爱显露心意。
18.en: A fool finds no pleasure in understanding but delights in airing his own opinions.

18.zh: 恶人来，藐视随来；羞耻到，辱骂同到。
18.en: When wickedness comes, so does contempt, and with shame comes disgrace.

18.zh: 人口中的言语如同深水；智慧的泉源好像涌流的河水。
18.en: The words of a man's mouth are deep waters, but the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook.

18.zh: 瞻徇恶人的情面，偏断义人的案件，都为不善。
18.en: It is not good to be partial to the wicked or to deprive the innocent of justice.

18.zh: 愚昧人张嘴启争端，开口招鞭打。
18.en: A fool's lips bring him strife, and his mouth invites a beating.

18.zh: 愚昧人的口自取败坏；他的嘴是他生命的网罗。
18.en: A fool's mouth is his undoing, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

18.zh: 传舌人的言语如同美食，深入人的心腹。
18.en: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels; they go down to a man's inmost parts.

18.zh: 做工懈怠的，与浪费人为弟兄。
18.en: One who is slack in his work is brother to one who destroys.

18.zh: 耶和华的名是坚固台；义人奔入便得安稳。
18.en: The name of the Lord is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

18.zh: 富足人的财物是他的坚城，在他心想，犹如高墙。
18.en: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city; they imagine it an unscalable wall.

18.zh: 败坏之先，人心骄傲；尊荣以前，必有谦卑。
18.en: Before his downfall a man's heart is proud, but humility comes before honor.

18.zh: 未曾听完先回答的，便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
18.en: He who answers before listening- that is his folly and his shame.

18.zh: 人有疾病，心能忍耐；心灵忧伤，谁能承当呢？
18.en: A man's spirit sustains him in sickness, but a crushed spirit who can bear?

18.zh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。
18.en: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge; the ears of the wise seek it out.

18.zh: 人的礼物为他开路，引他到高位的人面前。
18.en: A gift opens the way for the giver and ushers him into the presence of the great.

18.zh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。
18.en: The first to present his case seems right, till another comes forward and questions him.

18.zh: 掣签能止息争竞，也能解散强胜的人。
18.en: Casting the lot settles disputes and keeps strong opponents apart.

18.zh: 弟兄结怨，劝他和好，比取坚固城还难；这样的争竞如同坚寨的门闩。
18.en: An offended brother is more unyielding than a fortified city, and disputes are like the barred gates of a citadel.

18.zh: 人口中所结的果子，必充满肚腹；他嘴所出的，必使他饱足。
18.en: From the fruit of his mouth a man's stomach is filled; with the harvest from his lips he is satisfied.

18.zh: 生死在舌头的权下，喜爱他的，必吃他所结的果子。
18.en: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

18.zh: 得著贤妻的，是得著好处，也是蒙了耶和华的恩惠。
18.en: He who finds a wife finds what is good and receives favor from the Lord .

18.zh: 贫穷人说哀求的话；富足人用威吓的话回答。
18.en: A poor man pleads for mercy, but a rich man answers harshly.

18.zh: 滥交朋友的，自取败坏；但有一朋友比弟兄更亲密。
18.en: A man of many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

19.zh: 行为纯正的贫穷人胜过乖谬愚妄的富足人。
19.en: Better a poor man whose walk is blameless than a fool whose lips are perverse.

19.zh: 心无知识的，乃为不善；脚步急快的，难免犯罪。
19.en: It is not good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty and miss the way.

19.zh: 人的愚昧倾败他的道；他的心也抱怨耶和华。
19.en: A man's own folly ruins his life, yet his heart rages against the Lord .

19.zh: 财物使朋友增多；但穷人朋友远离。
19.en: Wealth brings many friends, but a poor man's friend deserts him.

19.zh: 作假见证的，必不免受罚；吐出谎言的，终不能逃脱。
19.en: A false witness will not go unpunished, and he who pours out lies will not go free.

19.zh: 好施散的，有多人求他的恩情；爱送礼的，人都为他的朋友。
19.en: Many curry favor with a ruler, and everyone is the friend of a man who gives gifts.

19.zh: 贫穷人，弟兄都恨他；何况他的朋友，更远离他！他用言语追随，他们却走了。
19.en: A poor man is shunned by all his relatives- how much more do his friends avoid him! Though he pursues them with pleading, they are nowhere to be found.

19.zh: 得著智慧的，爱惜生命；保守聪明的，必得好处。
19.en: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul; he who cherishes understanding prospers.

19.zh: 作假见证的，不免受罚；吐出谎言的，也必灭亡。
19.en: A false witness will not go unpunished, and he who pours out lies will perish.

19.zh: 愚昧人宴乐度日是不合宜的；何况仆人管辖王子呢？
19.en: It is not fitting for a fool to live in luxury- how much worse for a slave to rule over princes!

19.zh: 人有见识就不轻易发怒；宽恕人的过失便是自己的荣耀。
19.en: A man's wisdom gives him patience; it is to his glory to overlook an offense.

19.zh: 王的忿怒好像狮子吼叫；他的恩典却如草上的甘露。
19.en: A king's rage is like the roar of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

19.zh: 愚昧的儿子是父亲的祸患；妻子的争吵如雨连连滴漏。
19.en: A foolish son is his father's ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like a constant dripping.

19.zh: 房屋钱财是祖宗所遗留的；惟有贤慧的妻是耶和华所赐的。
19.en: Houses and wealth are inherited from parents, but a prudent wife is from the Lord .

19.zh: 懒惰使人沉睡；懈怠的人必受饥饿。
19.en: Laziness brings on deep sleep, and the shiftless man goes hungry.

19.zh: 谨守诫命的，保全生命；轻忽己路的，必致死亡。
19.en: He who obeys instructions guards his life, but he who is contemptuous of his ways will die.

19.zh: 怜悯贫穷的，就是借给耶和华；他的善行，耶和华必偿还。
19.en: He who is kind to the poor lends to the Lord , and he will reward him for what he has done.

19.zh: 趁有指望，管教你的儿子；你的心不可任他死亡。
19.en: Discipline your son, for in that there is hope; do not be a willing party to his death.

19.zh: 暴怒的人必受刑罚；你若救他，必须再救。
19.en: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty; if you rescue him, you will have to do it again.

19.zh: 你要听劝教，受训诲，使你终久有智慧。
19.en: Listen to advice and accept instruction, and in the end you will be wise.

19.zh: 人心多有计谋；惟有耶和华的筹算才能立定。
19.en: Many are the plans in a man's heart, but it is the Lord 's purpose that prevails.

19.zh: 施行仁慈的，令人爱慕；穷人强如说谎言的。
19.en: What a man desires is unfailing love ; better to be poor than a liar.

19.zh: 敬畏耶和华的，得著生命；他必恒久知足，不遭祸患。
19.en: The fear of the Lord leads to life: Then one rests content, untouched by trouble.

19.zh: 懒惰人放手在盘子里，就是向口撤回，他也不肯。
19.en: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth!

19.zh: 鞭打亵慢人，愚蒙人必长见识；责备明哲人，他就明白知识。
19.en: Flog a mocker, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke a discerning man, and he will gain knowledge.

19.zh: 虐待父亲 、 撵出母亲的，是贻羞致辱之子。
19.en: He who robs his father and drives out his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace.

19.zh: 我儿，不可听了教训而又偏离知识的言语。
19.en: Stop listening to instruction, my son, and you will stray from the words of knowledge.

19.zh: 匪徒作见证戏笑公平；恶人的口吞下罪孽。
19.en: A corrupt witness mocks at justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down evil.

19.zh: 刑罚是为亵慢人预备的；鞭打是为愚昧人的背预备的。
19.en: Penalties are prepared for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

20.zh: 酒能使人亵慢，浓酒使人喧嚷；凡因酒错误的，就无智慧。
20.en: Wine is a mocker and beer a brawler; whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

20.zh: 王的威吓如同狮子吼叫；惹动他怒的，是自害己命。
20.en: A king's wrath is like the roar of a lion; he who angers him forfeits his life.

20.zh: 远离纷争是人的尊荣；愚妄人都爱争闹。
20.en: It is to a man's honor to avoid strife, but every fool is quick to quarrel.

20.zh: 懒惰人因冬寒不肯耕种，到收割的时候，他必讨饭而无所得。
20.en: A sluggard does not plow in season; so at harvest time he looks but finds nothing.

20.zh: 人心怀藏谋略，好像深水，惟明哲人才能汲引出来。
20.en: The purposes of a man's heart are deep waters, but a man of understanding draws them out.

20.zh: 人多述说自己的仁慈，但忠信人谁能遇著呢？
20.en: Many a man claims to have unfailing love, but a faithful man who can find?

20.zh: 行为纯正的义人，他的子孙是有福的！
20.en: The righteous man leads a blameless life; blessed are his children after him.

20.zh: 王坐在审判的位上，以眼目驱散诸恶。
20.en: When a king sits on his throne to judge, he winnows out all evil with his eyes.

20.zh: 谁能说，我洁净了我的心，我脱净了我的罪？
20.en: Who can say, "I have kept my heart pure; I am clean and without sin"?

20.zh: 两样的法码，两样的升斗，都为耶和华所憎恶。
20.en: Differing weights and differing measures- the Lord detests them both.

20.zh: 孩童的动作是清洁，是正直，都显明他的本性。
20.en: Even a child is known by his actions, by whether his conduct is pure and right.

20.zh: 能听的耳，能看的眼，都是耶和华所造的。
20.en: Ears that hear and eyes that see- the Lord has made them both.

20.zh: 不要贪睡，免致贫穷；眼要睁开，你就吃饱。
20.en: Do not love sleep or you will grow poor; stay awake and you will have food to spare.

20.zh: 买物的说：不好，不好；及至买去，他便自夸。
20.en: "It's no good, it's no good!" says the buyer; then off he goes and boasts about his purchase.

20.zh: 有金子和许多珍珠（或译：红宝石），惟有知识的嘴乃为贵重的珍宝。
20.en: Gold there is, and rubies in abundance, but lips that speak knowledge are a rare jewel.

20.zh: 谁为生人作保，就拿谁的衣服；谁为外人作保，谁就要承当。
20.en: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if he does it for a wayward woman.

20.zh: 以虚谎而得的食物，人觉甘甜；但后来，他的口必充满尘沙。
20.en: Food gained by fraud tastes sweet to a man, but he ends up with a mouth full of gravel.

20.zh: 计谋都凭筹算立定；打仗要凭智谋。
20.en: Make plans by seeking advice; if you wage war, obtain guidance.

20.zh: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事；大张嘴的，不可与他结交。
20.en: A gossip betrays a confidence; so avoid a man who talks too much.

20.zh: 咒骂父母的，他的灯必灭，变为漆黑的黑暗。
20.en: If a man curses his father or mother, his lamp will be snuffed out in pitch darkness.

20.zh: 起初速得的产业，终久却不为福。
20.en: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning will not be blessed at the end.

20.zh: 你不要说，我要以恶报恶；要等候耶和华，他必拯救你。
20.en: Do not say, "I'll pay you back for this wrong!" Wait for the Lord , and he will deliver you.

20.zh: 两样的法码为耶和华所憎恶；诡诈的天平也为不善。
20.en: The Lord detests differing weights, and dishonest scales do not please him.

20.zh: 人的脚步为耶和华所定；人岂能明白自己的路呢？
20.en: A man's steps are directed by the Lord . How then can anyone understand his own way?

20.zh: 人冒失说，这是圣物，许愿之后才查问，就是自陷网罗。
20.en: It is a trap for a man to dedicate something rashly and only later to consider his vows.

20.zh: 智慧的王簸散恶人，用碌碡滚轧他们。
20.en: A wise king winnows out the wicked; he drives the threshing wheel over them.

20.zh: 人的灵是耶和华的灯，鉴察人的心腹。
20.en: The lamp of the Lord searches the spirit of a man ; it searches out his inmost being.

20.zh: 王因仁慈和诚实得以保全他的国位，也因仁慈立稳。
20.en: Love and faithfulness keep a king safe; through love his throne is made secure.

20.zh: 强壮乃少年人的荣耀；白发为老年人的尊荣。
20.en: The glory of young men is their strength, gray hair the splendor of the old.

20.zh: 鞭伤除净人的罪恶；责打能入人的心腹。
20.en: Blows and wounds cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the inmost being.

21.zh: 王的心在耶和华手中，好像陇沟的水随意流转。
21.en: The king's heart is in the hand of the Lord ; he directs it like a watercourse wherever he pleases.

21.zh: 人所行的，在自己眼中都看为正；惟有耶和华衡量人心。
21.en: All a man's ways seem right to him, but the Lord weighs the heart.

21.zh: 行仁义公平比献祭更蒙耶和华悦纳。
21.en: To do what is right and just is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.

21.zh: 恶人发达（发达：原文是灯），眼高心傲，这乃是罪。
21.en: Haughty eyes and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, are sin!

21.zh: 殷勤筹划的，足致丰裕；行事急躁的，都必缺乏。
21.en: The plans of the diligent lead to profit as surely as haste leads to poverty.

21.zh: 用诡诈之舌求财的，就是自己取死；所得之财乃是吹来吹去的浮云。
21.en: A fortune made by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor and a deadly snare.

21.zh: 恶人的强暴必将自己扫除，因他们不肯按公平行事。
21.en: The violence of the wicked will drag them away, for they refuse to do what is right.

21.zh: 负罪之人的路甚是弯曲；至于清洁的人，他所行的乃是正直。
21.en: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

21.zh: 宁可住在房顶的角上，不在宽阔的房屋与争吵的妇人同住。
21.en: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.

21.zh: 恶人的心乐人受祸；他眼并不怜恤邻舍。
21.en: The wicked man craves evil; his neighbor gets no mercy from him.

21.zh: 亵慢的人受刑罚，愚蒙的人就得智慧；智慧人受训诲，便得知识。
21.en: When a mocker is punished, the simple gain wisdom; when a wise man is instructed, he gets knowledge.

21.zh: 义人思想恶人的家，知道恶人倾倒，必致灭亡。
21.en: The Righteous One takes note of the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.

21.zh: 塞耳不听穷人哀求的，他将来呼吁也不蒙应允。
21.en: If a man shuts his ears to the cry of the poor, he too will cry out and not be answered.

21.zh: 暗中送的礼物挽回怒气；怀中搋的贿赂止息暴怒。
21.en: A gift given in secret soothes anger, and a bribe concealed in the cloak pacifies great wrath.

21.zh: 秉公行义使义人喜乐，使作孽的人败坏。
21.en: When justice is done, it brings joy to the righteous but terror to evildoers.

21.zh: 迷离通达道路的，必住在阴魂的会中。
21.en: A man who strays from the path of understanding comes to rest in the company of the dead.

21.zh: 爱宴乐的，必致穷乏；好酒，爱膏油的，必不富足。
21.en: He who loves pleasure will become poor; whoever loves wine and oil will never be rich.

21.zh: 恶人作了义人的赎价；奸诈人代替正直人。
21.en: The wicked become a ransom for the righteous, and the unfaithful for the upright.

21.zh: 宁可住在旷野，不与争吵使气的妇人同住。
21.en: Better to live in a desert than with a quarrelsome and ill-tempered wife.

21.zh: 智慧人家中积蓄宝物膏油；愚昧人随得来随吞下。
21.en: In the house of the wise are stores of choice food and oil, but a foolish man devours all he has.

21.zh: 追求公义仁慈的，就寻得生命 、 公义，和尊荣。
21.en: He who pursues righteousness and love finds life, prosperity and honor.

21.zh: 智慧人爬上勇士的城墙，倾覆他所倚靠的坚垒。
21.en: A wise man attacks the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.

21.zh: 谨守口与舌的，就保守自己免受灾难。
21.en: He who guards his mouth and his tongue keeps himself from calamity.

21.zh: 心骄气傲的人名叫亵慢；他行事狂妄，都出于骄傲。
21.en: The proud and arrogant man-"Mocker" is his name; he behaves with overweening pride.

21.zh: 懒惰人的心愿将他杀害，因为他手不肯做工。
21.en: The sluggard's craving will be the death of him, because his hands refuse to work.

21.zh: 有终日贪得无餍的；义人施舍而不吝惜。
21.en: All day long he craves for more, but the righteous give without sparing.

21.zh: 恶人的祭物是可憎的；何况他存恶意来献呢？
21.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable- how much more so when brought with evil intent!

21.zh: 作假见证的必灭亡；惟有听真情而言的，其言长存。
21.en: A false witness will perish, and whoever listens to him will be destroyed forever.

21.zh: 恶人脸无羞耻；正直人行事坚定。
21.en: A wicked man puts up a bold front, but an upright man gives thought to his ways.

21.zh: 没有人能以智慧 、 聪明 、 谋略敌挡耶和华。
21.en: There is no wisdom, no insight, no plan that can succeed against the Lord .

21.zh: 马是为打仗之日预备的；得胜乃在乎耶和华。
21.en: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but victory rests with the Lord .

22.zh: 美名胜过大财；恩宠强如金银。
22.en: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.

22.zh: 富户穷人在世相遇，都为耶和华所造。
22.en: Rich and poor have this in common: The Lord is the Maker of them all.

22.zh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。
22.en: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge, but the simple keep going and suffer for it.

22.zh: 敬畏耶和华心存谦卑，就得富有 、 尊荣 、 生命为赏赐。
22.en: Humility and the fear of the Lord bring wealth and honor and life.

22.zh: 乖僻人的路上有荆棘和网罗；保守自己生命的，必要远离。
22.en: In the paths of the wicked lie thorns and snares, but he who guards his soul stays far from them.

22.zh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。
22.en: Train a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not turn from it.

22.zh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。
22.en: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

22.zh: 撒罪孽的，必收灾祸；他逞怒的杖也必废掉。
22.en: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

22.zh: 眼目慈善的，就必蒙福，因他将食物分给穷人。
22.en: A generous man will himself be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.

22.zh: 赶出亵慢人，争端就消除；纷争和羞辱也必止息。
22.en: Drive out the mocker, and out goes strife; quarrels and insults are ended.

22.zh: 喜爱清心的人因他嘴上的恩言，王必与他为友。
22.en: He who loves a pure heart and whose speech is gracious will have the king for his friend.

22.zh: 耶和华的眼目眷顾聪明人，却倾败奸诈人的言语。
22.en: The eyes of the Lord keep watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

22.zh: 懒惰人说：外头有狮子；我在街上就必被杀。
22.en: The sluggard says, "There is a lion outside!" or, "I will be murdered in the streets!"

22.zh: 淫妇的口为深坑；耶和华所憎恶的，必陷在其中。
22.en: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit; he who is under the Lord 's wrath will fall into it.

22.zh: 愚蒙迷住孩童的心，用管教的杖可以远远赶除。
22.en: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline will drive it far from him.

22.zh: 欺压贫穷为要利己的，并送礼与富户的，都必缺乏。
22.en: He who oppresses the poor to increase his wealth and he who gives gifts to the rich-both come to poverty. Sayings of the Wise

22.zh: 你须侧耳听受智慧人的言语，留心领会我的知识。
22.en: Pay attention and listen to the sayings of the wise; apply your heart to what I teach,

22.zh: 你若心中存记，嘴上咬定，这便为美。
22.en: for it is pleasing when you keep them in your heart and have all of them ready on your lips.

22.zh: 我今日以此特特指教你，为要使你倚靠耶和华。
22.en: So that your trust may be in the Lord , I teach you today, even you.

22.zh: 谋略和知识的美事，我岂没有写给你么？
22.en: Have I not written thirty sayings for you, sayings of counsel and knowledge,

22.zh: 要使你知道真言的实理，你好将真言回覆那打发你来的人。
22.en: teaching you true and reliable words, so that you can give sound answers to him who sent you?

22.zh: 贫穷人，你不可因他贫穷就抢夺他的物，也不可在城门口欺压困苦人；
22.en: Do not exploit the poor because they are poor and do not crush the needy in court,

22.zh: 因耶和华必为他辨屈；抢夺他的，耶和华必夺取那人的命。
22.en: for the Lord will take up their case and will plunder those who plunder them.

22.zh: 好生气的人，不可与他结交；暴怒的人，不可与他来往；
22.en: Do not make friends with a hot-tempered man, do not associate with one easily angered,

22.zh: 恐怕你效法他的行为，自己就陷在网罗里。
22.en: or you may learn his ways and get yourself ensnared.

22.zh: 不要与人击掌，不要为欠债的作保。
22.en: Do not be a man who strikes hands in pledge or puts up security for debts;

22.zh: 你若没有甚么偿还，何必使人夺去你睡卧的床呢？
22.en: if you lack the means to pay, your very bed will be snatched from under you.

22.zh: 你先祖所立的地界，你不可挪移。
22.en: Do not move an ancient boundary stone set up by your forefathers.

22.zh: 你看见办事殷勤的人么？他必站在君王面前，必不站在下贱人面前。
22.en: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve before kings; he will not serve before obscure men.

23.zh: 你若与官长坐席，要留意在你面前的是谁。
23.en: When you sit to dine with a ruler,note well what is before you,

23.zh: 你若是贪食的，就当拿刀放在喉咙上。
23.en: and put a knife to your throat if you are given to gluttony.

23.zh: 不可贪恋他的美食，因为是哄人的食物。
23.en: Do not crave his delicacies, for that food is deceptive.

23.zh: 不要劳碌求富，休仗自己的聪明。
23.en: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; have the wisdom to show restraint.

23.zh: 你岂要定睛在虚无的钱财上么？因钱财必长翅膀，如鹰向天飞去。
23.en: Cast but a glance at riches, and they are gone, for they will surely sprout wings and fly off to the sky like an eagle.

23.zh: 不要吃恶眼人的饭，也不要贪他的美味；
23.en: Do not eat the food of a stingy man, do not crave his delicacies;

23.zh: 因为他心怎样思量，他为人就是怎样。他虽对你说，请吃，请喝，他的心却与你相背。
23.en: for he is the kind of man who is always thinking about the cost. "Eat and drink," he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

23.zh: 你所吃的那点食物必吐出来；你所说的甘美言语也必落空。
23.en: You will vomit up the little you have eaten and will have wasted your compliments.

23.zh: 你不要说话给愚昧人听，因他必藐视你智慧的言语。
23.en: Do not speak to a fool, for he will scorn the wisdom of your words.

23.zh: 不可挪移古时的地界，也不可侵入孤儿的田地；
23.en: Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

23.zh: 因他们的救赎主大有能力，他必向你为他们辨屈。
23.en: for their Defender is strong; he will take up their case against you.

23.zh: 你要留心领受训诲，侧耳听从知识的言语。
23.en: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge.

23.zh: 不可不管教孩童；你用杖打他，他必不至于死。
23.en: Do not withhold discipline from a child; if you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

23.zh: 你要用杖打他，就可以救他的灵魂免下阴间。
23.en: Punish him with the rod and save his soul from death.

23.zh: 我儿，你心若存智慧，我的心也甚欢喜。
23.en: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad;

23.zh: 你的嘴若说正直话，我的心肠也必快乐。
23.en: my inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

23.zh: 你心中不要嫉妒罪人，只要终日敬畏耶和华；
23.en: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always be zealous for the fear of the Lord .

23.zh: 因为至终必有善报，你的指望也不致断绝。
23.en: There is surely a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

23.zh: 我儿，你当听，当存智慧，好在正道上引导你的心。
23.en: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path.

23.zh: 好饮酒的，好吃肉的，不要与他们来往；
23.en: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat,

23.zh: 因为好酒贪食的，必致贫穷；好睡觉的，必穿破烂衣服。
23.en: for drunkards and gluttons become poor, and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

23.zh: 你要听从生你的父亲；你母亲老了，也不可藐视他。
23.en: Listen to your father, who gave you life, and do not despise your mother when she is old.

23.zh: 你当买真理；就是智慧 、 训诲，和聪明也都不可卖。
23.en: Buy the truth and do not sell it; get wisdom, discipline and understanding. Note: Other Bible Versions Use: Acquire truth (NET Bible) or Get the truth (NLT) instead of Buy the truth

23.zh: 义人的父亲必大得快乐；人生智慧的儿子，必因他欢喜。
23.en: The father of a righteous man has great joy; he who has a wise son delights in him.

23.zh: 你要使父母欢喜，使生你的快乐。
23.en: May your father and mother be glad; may she who gave you birth rejoice!

23.zh: 我儿，要将你的心归我；你的眼目也要喜悦我的道路。
23.en: My son, give me your heart and let your eyes keep to my ways,

23.zh: 妓女是深坑；外女是窄阱。
23.en: for a prostitute is a deep pit and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

23.zh: 他埋伏好像强盗；他使人中多有奸诈的。
23.en: Like a bandit she lies in wait, and multiplies the unfaithful among men.

23.zh: 谁有祸患？谁有忧愁？谁有争斗？谁有哀叹（或译：怨言）？谁无故受伤？谁眼目红赤？
23.en: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

23.zh: 就是那流连饮酒 、 常去寻找调和酒的人。
23.en: Those who linger over wine, who go to sample bowls of mixed wine.

23.zh: 酒发红，在杯中闪烁，你不可观看，虽然下咽舒畅，终久是咬你如蛇，刺你如毒蛇。
23.en: Do not gaze at wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly!

23.zh: a
23.en: In the end it bites like a snake and poisons like a viper.

23.zh: 你眼必看见异怪的事（或译：淫妇）；你心必发出乖谬的话。
23.en: Your eyes will see strange sights and your mind imagine confusing things.

23.zh: 你必像躺在海中，或像卧在桅杆上。
23.en: You will be like one sleeping on the high seas, lying on top of the rigging.

23.zh: 你必说：人打我，我却未受伤；人鞭打我，我竟不觉得。我几时清醒，我仍去寻酒。
23.en: "They hit me," you will say, "but I'm not hurt! They beat me, but I don't feel it! When will I wake up so I can find another drink?"

24.zh: 你不要嫉妒恶人，也不要起意与他们相处；
24.en: Do not envy wicked men, do notdesire their company;

24.zh: 因为，他们的心图谋强暴，他们的口谈论奸恶。
24.en: for their hearts plot violence, and their lips talk about making trouble.

24.zh: 房屋因智慧建造，又因聪明立稳；
24.en: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established;

24.zh: 其中因知识充满各样美好宝贵的财物。
24.en: through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.

24.zh: 智慧人大有能力；有知识的人力上加力。
