24.en: A wise man has great power, and a man of knowledge increases strength;

24.zh: 你去打仗，要凭智谋；谋士众多，人便得胜。
24.en: for waging war you need guidance, and for victory many advisers.

24.zh: 智慧极高，非愚昧人所能及，所以在城门内不敢开口。
24.en: Wisdom is too high for a fool; in the assembly at the gate he has nothing to say.

24.zh: 设计作恶的，必称为奸人。
24.en: He who plots evil will be known as a schemer.

24.zh: 愚妄人的思念乃是罪恶；亵慢者为人所憎恶。
24.en: The schemes of folly are sin, and men detest a mocker.

24.zh: 你在患难之日若胆怯，你的力量就微小。
24.en: If you falter in times of trouble, how small is your strength!

24.zh: 人被拉到死地，你要解救；人将被杀，你须拦阻。
24.en: Rescue those being led away to death; hold back those staggering toward slaughter.

24.zh: 你若说：这事我未曾知道，那衡量人心的岂不明白么？保守你命的岂不知道么？他岂不按各人所行的报应各人么？
24.en: If you say, "But we knew nothing about this," does not he who weighs the heart perceive it? Does not he who guards your life know it? Will he not repay each person according to what he has done?

24.zh: 我儿，你要吃蜜，因为是好的；吃蜂房下滴的蜜便觉甘甜。
24.en: Eat honey, my son, for it is good; honey from the comb is sweet to your taste.

24.zh: 你心得了智慧，也必觉得如此。你若找著，至终必有善报；你的指望也不致断绝。
24.en: Know also that wisdom is sweet to your soul; if you find it, there is a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

24.zh: 你这恶人，不要埋伏攻击义人的家；不要毁坏他安居之所。
24.en: Do not lie in wait like an outlaw against a righteous man's house, do not raid his dwelling place;

24.zh: 因为，义人虽七次跌倒，仍必兴起；恶人却被祸患倾倒。
24.en: for though a righteous man falls seven times, he rises again, but the wicked are brought down by calamity.

24.zh: 你仇敌跌倒，你不要欢喜；他倾倒，你心不要快乐；
24.en: Do not gloat when your enemy falls; when he stumbles, do not let your heart rejoice,

24.zh: 恐怕耶和华看见就不喜悦，将怒气从仇敌身上转过来。
24.en: or the Lord will see and disapprove and turn his wrath away from him.

24.zh: 不要为作恶的心怀不平，也不要嫉妒恶人；
24.en: Do not fret because of evil men or be envious of the wicked,

24.zh: 因为，恶人终不得善报；恶人的灯也必熄灭。
24.en: for the evil man has no future hope, and the lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

24.zh: 我儿，你要敬畏耶和华与君王，不要与反覆无常的人结交，
24.en: Fear the Lord and the king, my son, and do not join with the rebellious,

24.zh: 因为他们的灾难必忽然而起。耶和华与君王所施行的毁灭，谁能知道呢？
24.en: for those two will send sudden destruction upon them, and who knows what calamities they can bring? Further Sayings of the Wise

24.zh: 以下也是智慧人的箴言：审判时看人情面是不好的。
24.en: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judging is not good:

24.zh: 对恶人说：你是义人的，这人万民必咒诅，列邦必憎恶。
24.en: Whoever says to the guilty, "You are innocent"- peoples will curse him and nations denounce him.

24.zh: 责备恶人的，必得喜悦；美好的福也必临到他。
24.en: But it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and rich blessing will come upon them.

24.zh: 应对正直的，犹如与人亲嘴。
24.en: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

24.zh: 你要在外头预备工料，在田间办理整齐，然后建造房屋。
24.en: Finish your outdoor work and get your fields ready; after that, build your house.

24.zh: 不可无故作见证陷害邻舍，也不可用嘴欺骗人。
24.en: Do not testify against your neighbor without cause, or use your lips to deceive.

24.zh: 不可说：人怎样待我，我也怎样待他；我必照他所行的报复他。
24.en: Do not say, "I'll do to him as he has done to me; I'll pay that man back for what he did."

24.zh: 我经过懒惰人的田地 、 无知人的葡萄园，
24.en: I went past the field of the sluggard, past the vineyard of the man who lacks judgment;

24.zh: 荆棘长满了地皮，刺草遮盖了田面，石墙也坍塌了。
24.en: thorns had come up everywhere, the ground was covered with weeds, and the stone wall was in ruins.

24.zh: 我看见就留心思想；我看著就领了训诲。
24.en: I applied my heart to what I observed and learned a lesson from what I saw:

24.zh: 再睡片时，打盹片时，抱著手躺卧片时，
24.en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest-

24.zh: 你的贫穷就必如强盗速来，你的缺乏彷佛拿兵器的人来到。
24.en: and poverty will come on you like a bandit and scarcity like an armed man.

25.zh: 以下也是所罗门的箴言，是犹大王希西家的人所誊录的。
25.en: These are more proverbs of Solomon, copied by the men of Hezekiah king of Judah:

25.zh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。
25.en: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.

25.zh: 天之高，地之厚，君王之心也测不透。
25.en: As the heavens are high and the earth is deep, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

25.zh: 除去银子的渣滓就有银子出来，银匠能以做器皿。
25.en: Remove the dross from the silver, and out comes material for the silversmith;

25.zh: 除去王面前的恶人，国位就靠公义坚立。
25.en: remove the wicked from the king's presence, and his throne will be established through righteousness.

25.zh: 不要在王面前妄自尊大；不要在大人的位上站立。
25.en: Do not exalt yourself in the king's presence, and do not claim a place among great men;

25.zh: 宁可有人说：请你上来，强如在你觐见的王子面前叫你退下。
25.en: it is better for him to say to you, "Come up here," than for him to humiliate you before a nobleman. What you have seen with your eyes

25.zh: 不要冒失出去与人争竞，免得至终被他羞辱，你就不知道怎样行了。
25.en: do not bring hastily to court, for what will you do in the end if your neighbor puts you to shame?

25.zh: 你与邻舍争讼，要与他一人辩论，不可泄漏人的密事，
25.en: If you argue your case with a neighbor, do not betray another man's confidence,

25.zh: 恐怕听见的人骂你，你的臭名就难以脱离。
25.en: or he who hears it may shame you and you will never lose your bad reputation.

25.zh: 一句话说得合宜，就如金苹果在银网子里。
25.en: A word aptly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

25.zh: 智慧人的劝戒，在顺从的人耳中，好像金耳环和精金的妆饰。
25.en: Like an earring of gold or an ornament of fine gold is a wise man's rebuke to a listening ear.

25.zh: 忠信的使者叫差他的人心里舒畅，就如在收割时有冰雪的凉气。
25.en: Like the coolness of snow at harvest time is a trustworthy messenger to those who send him; he refreshes the spirit of his masters.

25.zh: 空夸赠送礼物的，好像无雨的风云。
25.en: Like clouds and wind without rain is a man who boasts of gifts he does not give.

25.zh: 恒常忍耐可以劝动君王；柔和的舌头能折断骨头。
25.en: Through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.

25.zh: 你得了蜜么？只可吃够而已，恐怕你过饱就呕吐出来。
25.en: If you find honey, eat just enough- too much of it, and you will vomit.

25.zh: 你的脚要少进邻舍的家，恐怕他厌烦你，恨恶你。
25.en: Seldom set foot in your neighbor's house- too much of you, and he will hate you.

25.zh: 作假见证陷害邻舍的，就是大槌，是利刀，是快箭。
25.en: Like a club or a sword or a sharp arrow is the man who gives false testimony against his neighbor.

25.zh: 患难时倚靠不忠诚的人，好像破坏的牙，错骨缝的脚。
25.en: Like a bad tooth or a lame foot is reliance on the unfaithful in times of trouble.

25.zh: 对伤心的人唱歌，就如冷天脱衣服，又如碱上倒醋。
25.en: Like one who takes away a garment on a cold day, or like vinegar poured on soda, is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

25.zh: 你的仇敌若饿了，就给他饭吃；若渴了，就给他水喝；
25.en: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat; if he is thirsty, give him water to drink.

25.zh: 因为，你这样行就是把炭火堆在他的头上；耶和华也必赏赐你。
25.en: In doing this, you will heap burning coals on his head, and the Lord will reward you.

25.zh: 北风生雨，谗谤人的舌头也生怒容。
25.en: As a north wind brings rain, so a sly tongue brings angry looks.

25.zh: 宁可住在房顶的角上，不在宽阔的房屋与争吵的妇人同住。
25.en: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.

25.zh: 有好消息从远方来，就如拿凉水给口渴的人喝。
25.en: Like cold water to a weary soul is good news from a distant land.

25.zh: 义人在恶人面前退缩，好像逿浑之泉，弄浊之井。
25.en: Like a muddied spring or a polluted well is a righteous man who gives way to the wicked.

25.zh: 吃蜜过多是不好的；考究自己的荣耀也是可厌的。
25.en: It is not good to eat too much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one's own honor.

25.zh: 人不制伏自己的心，好像毁坏的城邑没有墙垣。
25.en: Like a city whose walls are broken down is a man who lacks self-control.

26.zh: 夏天落雪，收割时下雨，都不相宜；愚昧人得尊荣也是如此。
26.en: Like snow in summer or rain inharvest, honor is not fitting for a fool.

26.zh: 麻雀往来，燕子翻飞；这样，无故的咒诅也必不临到。
26.en: Like a fluttering sparrow or a darting swallow, an undeserved curse does not come to rest.

26.zh: 鞭子是为打马，辔头是为勒驴；刑杖是为打愚昧人的背。
26.en: A whip for the horse, a halter for the donkey, and a rod for the backs of fools!

26.zh: 不要照愚昧人的愚妄话回答他，恐怕你与他一样。
26.en: Do not answer a fool according to his folly, or you will be like him yourself.

26.zh: 要照愚昧人的愚妄话回答他，免得他自以为有智慧。
26.en: Answer a fool according to his folly, or he will be wise in his own eyes.

26.zh: 藉愚昧人手寄信的，是砍断自己的脚，自受（原文是：喝）损害。
26.en: Like cutting off one's feet or drinking violence is the sending of a message by the hand of a fool.

26.zh: 瘸子的脚空存无用；箴言在愚昧人的口中也是如此。
26.en: Like a lame man's legs that hang limp is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.

26.zh: 将尊荣给愚昧人的，好像人把石子包在机弦里。
26.en: Like tying a stone in a sling is the giving of honor to a fool.

26.zh: 箴言在愚昧人的口中，好像荆棘刺入醉汉的手。
26.en: Like a thornbush in a drunkard's hand is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.

26.zh: 雇愚昧人的，与雇过路人的，就像射伤众人的弓箭手。
26.en: Like an archer who wounds at random is he who hires a fool or any passer-by.

26.zh: 愚昧人行愚妄事，行了又行，就如狗转过来吃他所吐的。
26.en: As a dog returns to its vomit, so a fool repeats his folly.

26.zh: 你见自以为有智慧的人么？愚昧人比他更有指望。
26.en: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

26.zh: 懒惰人说：道上有猛狮，街上有壮狮。
26.en: The sluggard says, "There is a lion in the road, a fierce lion roaming the streets!"

26.zh: 门在枢纽转动，懒惰人在床上也是如此。
26.en: As a door turns on its hinges, so a sluggard turns on his bed.

26.zh: 懒惰人放手在盘子里，就是向口撤回也以为劳乏。
26.en: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

26.zh: 懒惰人看自己比七个善于应对的人更有智慧。
26.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer discreetly.

26.zh: 过路被事激动，管理不干己的争竞，好像人揪住狗耳。
26.en: Like one who seizes a dog by the ears is a passer-by who meddles in a quarrel not his own.

26.zh: 人欺凌邻舍，却说：我岂不是戏耍么？他就像疯狂的人抛掷火把 、 利箭，与杀人的兵器（原文是死亡）。
26.en: Like a madman shooting firebrands or deadly arrows

26.zh: a
26.en: is a man who deceives his neighbor and says, "I was only joking!"

26.zh: 火缺了柴就必熄灭；无人传舌，争竞便止息。
26.en: Without wood a fire goes out; without gossip a quarrel dies down.

26.zh: 好争竞的人煽惑争端，就如余火加炭，火上加柴一样。
26.en: As charcoal to embers and as wood to fire, so is a quarrelsome man for kindling strife.

26.zh: 传舌人的言语，如同美食，深入人的心腹。
26.en: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels; they go down to a man's inmost parts.

26.zh: 火热的嘴，奸恶的心，好像银渣包的瓦器。
26.en: Like a coating of glaze over earthenware are fervent lips with an evil heart.

26.zh: 怨恨人的，用嘴粉饰，心里却藏著诡诈；
26.en: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but in his heart he harbors deceit.

26.zh: 他用甜言蜜语，你不可信他，因为他心中有七样可憎恶的。
26.en: Though his speech is charming, do not believe him, for seven abominations fill his heart.

26.zh: 他虽用诡诈遮掩自己的怨恨，他的邪恶必在会中显露。
26.en: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

26.zh: 挖陷坑的，自己必掉在其中；滚石头的，石头必反滚在他身上。
26.en: If a man digs a pit, he will fall into it; if a man rolls a stone, it will roll back on him.

26.zh: 虚谎的舌恨他所压伤的人；谄媚的口败坏人的事。
26.en: A lying tongue hates those it hurts, and a flattering mouth works ruin.

27.zh: 不要为明日自夸，因为一日要生何事，你尚且不能知道。
27.en: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring forth.

27.zh: 要别人夸奖你，不可用口自夸；等外人称赞你，不可用嘴自称。
27.en: Let another praise you, and not your own mouth; someone else, and not your own lips.

27.zh: 石头重，沙土沉，愚妄人的恼怒比这两样更重。
27.en: Stone is heavy and sand a burden, but provocation by a fool is heavier than both.

27.zh: 忿怒为残忍，怒气为狂澜，惟有嫉妒，谁能敌得住呢？
27.en: Anger is cruel and fury overwhelming, but who can stand before jealousy?

27.zh: 当面的责备强如背地的爱情。
27.en: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

27.zh: 朋友加的伤痕出于忠诚；仇敌连连亲嘴却是多余。
27.en: Wounds from a friend can be trusted, but an enemy multiplies kisses.

27.zh: 人吃饱了，厌恶蜂房的蜜；人饥饿了，一切苦物都觉甘甜。
27.en: He who is full loathes honey, but to the hungry even what is bitter tastes sweet.

27.zh: 人离本处飘流，好像雀鸟离窝游飞。
27.en: Like a bird that strays from its nest is a man who strays from his home.

27.zh: 膏油与香料使人心喜悦；朋友诚实的劝教也是如此甘美。
27.en: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart, and the pleasantness of one's friend springs from his earnest counsel.

27.zh: 你的朋友和父亲的朋友，你都不可离弃。你遭难的日子，不要上弟兄的家去；相近的邻舍强如远方的弟兄。
27.en: Do not forsake your friend and the friend of your father, and do not go to your brother's house when disaster strikes you- better a neighbor nearby than a brother far away.

27.zh: 我儿，你要作智慧人，好叫我的心欢喜，使我可以回答那讥诮我的人。
27.en: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart; then I can answer anyone who treats me with contempt.

27.zh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。
27.en: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and suffer for it.

27.zh: 谁为生人作保，就拿谁的衣服；谁为外女作保，谁就承当。
27.en: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if he does it for a wayward woman.

27.zh: 清晨起来，大声给朋友祝福的，就算是咒诅他。
27.en: If a man loudly blesses his neighbor early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse.

27.zh: 大雨之日连连滴漏，和争吵的妇人一样；
27.en: A quarrelsome wife is like a constant dripping on a rainy day;

27.zh: 想拦阻他的，便是拦阻风，也是右手抓油。
27.en: restraining her is like restraining the wind or grasping oil with the hand.

27.zh: 铁磨铁，磨出刃来；朋友相感（原文是磨朋友的脸）也是如此。
27.en: As iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another.

27.zh: 看守无花果树的，必吃树上的果子；敬奉主人的，必得尊荣。
27.en: He who tends a fig tree will eat its fruit, and he who looks after his master will be honored.

27.zh: 水中照脸，彼此相符；人与人，心也相对。
27.en: As water reflects a face, so a man's heart reflects the man.

27.zh: 阴间和灭亡永不满足；人的眼目也是如此。
27.en: Death and Destruction are never satisfied, and neither are the eyes of man.

27.zh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。
27.en: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but man is tested by the praise he receives.

27.zh: 你虽用杵将愚妄人与打碎的麦子一同捣在臼中，他的愚妄还是离不了他。
27.en: Though you grind a fool in a mortar, grinding him like grain with a pestle, you will not remove his folly from him.

27.zh: 你要详细知道你羊群的景况，留心料理你的牛群；
27.en: Be sure you know the condition of your flocks, give careful attention to your herds;

27.zh: 因为资财不能永有，冠冕岂能存到万代？
27.en: for riches do not endure forever, and a crown is not secure for all generations.

27.zh: 干草割去，嫩草发现，山上的菜蔬也被收敛。
27.en: When the hay is removed and new growth appears and the grass from the hills is gathered in,

27.zh: 羊羔之毛是为你作衣服；山羊是为作田地的价值，
27.en: the lambs will provide you with clothing, and the goats with the price of a field.

27.zh: 并有母山羊奶够你吃，也够你的家眷吃，且够养你的婢女。
27.en: You will have plenty of goats' milk to feed you and your family and to nourish your servant girls.

28.zh: 恶人虽无人追赶也逃跑；义人却胆壮像狮子。
28.en: The wicked man flees though no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

28.zh: 邦国因有罪过，君王就多更换；因有聪明知识的人，国必长存。
28.en: When a country is rebellious, it has many rulers, but a man of understanding and knowledge maintains order.

28.zh: 穷人欺压贫民，好像暴雨冲没粮食。
28.en: A ruler who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain that leaves no crops.

28.zh: 违弃律法的，夸奖恶人；遵守律法的，却与恶人相争。
28.en: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, but those who keep the law resist them.

28.zh: 坏人不明白公义；惟有寻求耶和华的，无不明白。
28.en: Evil men do not understand justice, but those who seek the Lord understand it fully.

28.zh: 行为纯正的穷乏人胜过行事乖僻的富足人。
28.en: Better a poor man whose walk is blameless than a rich man whose ways are perverse.

28.zh: 谨守律法的，是智慧之子；与贪食人作伴的，却羞辱其父。
28.en: He who keeps the law is a discerning son, but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father.

28.zh: 人以厚利加增财物，是给那怜悯穷人者积蓄的。
28.en: He who increases his wealth by exorbitant interest amasses it for another, who will be kind to the poor.

28.zh: 转耳不听律法的，他的祈祷也为可憎。
28.en: If anyone turns a deaf ear to the law, even his prayers are detestable.

28.zh: 诱惑正直人行恶道的，必掉在自己的坑里；惟有完全人必承受福分。
28.en: He who leads the upright along an evil path will fall into his own trap, but the blameless will receive a good inheritance.

28.zh: 富足人自以为有智慧，但聪明的贫穷人能将他查透。
28.en: A rich man may be wise in his own eyes, but a poor man who has discernment sees through him.

28.zh: 义人得志，有大荣耀；恶人兴起，人就躲藏。
28.en: When the righteous triumph, there is great elation; but when the wicked rise to power, men go into hiding.

28.zh: 遮掩自己罪过的，必不亨通；承认离弃罪过的，必蒙怜恤。
28.en: He who conceals his sins does not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

28.zh: 常存敬畏的，便为有福；心存刚硬的，必陷在祸患里。
28.en: Blessed is the man who always fears the Lord , but he who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

28.zh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子 、 觅食的熊。
28.en: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked man ruling over a helpless people.

28.zh: 无知的君多行暴虐；以贪财为可恨的，必年长日久。
28.en: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment, but he who hates ill-gotten gain will enjoy a long life.

28.zh: 背负流人血之罪的，必往坑里奔跑，谁也不可拦阻他。
28.en: A man tormented by the guilt of murder will be a fugitive till death; let no one support him.

28.zh: 行动正直的，必蒙拯救；行事弯曲的，立时跌倒。
28.en: He whose walk is blameless is kept safe, but he whose ways are perverse will suddenly fall.

28.zh: 耕种自己田地的，必得饱食；追随虚浮的，足受穷乏。
28.en: He who works his land will have abundant food, but the one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

28.zh: 诚实人必多得福；想要急速发财的，不免受罚。
28.en: A faithful man will be richly blessed, but one eager to get rich will not go unpunished.

28.zh: 看人的情面乃为不好；人因一块饼枉法也为不好。
28.en: To show partiality is not good- yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

28.zh: 人有恶眼想要急速发财，却不知穷乏必临到他身。
28.en: A stingy man is eager to get rich and is unaware that poverty awaits him.

28.zh: 责备人的，后来蒙人喜悦，多于那用舌头谄媚人的。
28.en: He who rebukes a man will in the end gain more favor than he who has a flattering tongue.

28.zh: 偷窃父母的，说：这不是罪，此人就是与强盗同类。
28.en: He who robs his father or mother and says, "It's not wrong"- he is partner to him who destroys.

28.zh: 心中贪婪的，挑起争端；倚靠耶和华的，必得丰裕。
28.en: A greedy man stirs up dissension, but he who trusts in the Lord will prosper.

28.zh: 心中自是的，便是愚昧人；凭智慧行事的，必蒙拯救。
28.en: He who trusts in himself is a fool, but he who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

28.zh: 赒济贫穷的，不致缺乏；佯为不见的，必多受咒诅。
28.en: He who gives to the poor will lack nothing, but he who closes his eyes to them receives many curses.

28.zh: 恶人兴起，人就躲藏；恶人败亡，义人增多。
28.en: When the wicked rise to power, people go into hiding; but when the wicked perish, the righteous thrive.

29.zh: 人屡次受责罚，仍然硬著颈项；他必顷刻败坏，无法可治。
29.en: A man who remains stiff-necked after many rebukes will suddenly be destroyed-without remedy.

29.zh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。
29.en: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.

29.zh: 爱慕智慧的，使父亲喜乐；与妓女结交的，却浪费钱财。
29.en: A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father, but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

29.zh: 王藉公平，使国坚定；索要贿赂，使国倾败。
29.en: By justice a king gives a country stability, but one who is greedy for bribes tears it down.

29.zh: 谄媚邻舍的，就是设网罗绊他的脚。
29.en: Whoever flatters his neighbor is spreading a net for his feet.

29.zh: 恶人犯罪，自陷网罗；惟独义人欢呼喜乐。
29.en: An evil man is snared by his own sin, but a righteous one can sing and be glad.

29.zh: 义人知道查明穷人的案；恶人没有聪明，就不得而知。
29.en: The righteous care about justice for the poor, but the wicked have no such concern.

29.zh: 亵慢人煽惑通城；智慧人止息众怒。
29.en: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

29.zh: 智慧人与愚妄人相争，或怒或笑，总不能使他止息。
29.en: If a wise man goes to court with a fool, the fool rages and scoffs, and there is no peace.

29.zh: 好流人血的，恨恶完全人，索取正直人的性命。
29.en: Bloodthirsty men hate a man of integrity and seek to kill the upright.

29.zh: 愚妄人怒气全发；智慧人忍气含怒。
29.en: A fool gives full vent to his anger, but a wise man keeps himself under control.

29.zh: 君王若听谎言，他一切臣仆都是奸恶。
29.en: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials become wicked.

29.zh: 贫穷人 、 强暴人在世相遇；他们的眼目都蒙耶和华光照。
29.en: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The Lord gives sight to the eyes of both.

29.zh: 君王凭诚实判断穷人；他的国位必永远坚立。
29.en: If a king judges the poor with fairness, his throne will always be secure.

29.zh: 杖打和责备能加增智慧；放纵的儿子使母亲羞愧。
29.en: The rod of correction imparts wisdom, but a child left to himself disgraces his mother.

29.zh: 恶人加多，过犯也加多，义人必看见他们跌倒。
29.en: When the wicked thrive, so does sin, but the righteous will see their downfall.

29.zh: 管教你的儿子，他就使你得安息，也必使你心里喜乐。
29.en: Discipline your son, and he will give you peace; he will bring delight to your soul.

29.zh: 没有异象（或译：默示），民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。
29.en: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but blessed is he who keeps the law.

29.zh: 只用言语，仆人不肯受管教；他虽然明白，也不留意。
29.en: A servant cannot be corrected by mere words; though he understands, he will not respond.

29.zh: 你见言语急躁的人吗？愚昧人比他更有指望。
29.en: Do you see a man who speaks in haste? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

29.zh: 人将仆人从小娇养，这仆人终久必成了他的儿子。
29.en: If a man pampers his servant from youth, he will bring grief in the end.

29.zh: 好气的人挑启争端；暴怒的人多多犯罪。
29.en: An angry man stirs up dissension, and a hot-tempered one commits many sins.

29.zh: 人的高傲必使他卑下；心里谦逊的，必得尊荣。
29.en: A man's pride brings him low, but a man of lowly spirit gains honor.

29.zh: 人与盗贼分赃，是恨恶自己的性命；他听见叫人发誓的声音，却不言语。
29.en: The accomplice of a thief is his own enemy; he is put under oath and dare not testify.

29.zh: 惧怕人的，陷入网罗；惟有倚靠耶和华的，必得安稳。
29.en: Fear of man will prove to be a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is kept safe.

29.zh: 求王恩的人多；定人事乃在耶和华。
29.en: Many seek an audience with a ruler, but it is from the Lord that man gets justice.

29.zh: 为非作歹的，被义人憎嫌；行事正直的，被恶人憎恶。
29.en: The righteous detest the dishonest; the wicked detest the upright.

30.zh: 雅基的儿子亚古珥的言语就是真言。这人对以铁和乌甲说：
30.en: The sayings of Agur son of Jakeh- an oracle : This man declared to Ithiel, to Ithiel and to Ucal:

30.zh: 我比众人更蠢笨，也没有人的聪明。
30.en: "I am the most ignorant of men; I do not have a man's understanding.

30.zh: 我没有学好智慧，也不认识至圣者。
30.en: I have not learned wisdom, nor have I knowledge of the Holy One.

30.zh: 谁升天又降下来？谁聚风在掌握中？谁包水在衣服里？谁立定地的四极？他名叫甚么？他儿子名叫甚么？你知道吗？
30.en: Who has gone up to heaven and come down? Who has gathered up the wind in the hollow of his hands? Who has wrapped up the waters in his cloak? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and the name of his son? Tell me if you know!

30.zh: 神的言语句句都是炼净的；投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。
30.en: "Every word of God is flawless; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

30.zh: 他的言语，你不可加添，恐怕他责备你，你就显为说谎言的。
30.en: Do not add to his words, or he will rebuke you and prove you a liar.

30.zh: 我求你两件事，在我未死之先，不要不赐给我：
30.en: "Two things I ask of you, O Lord ; do not refuse me before I die:

30.zh: 求你使虚假和谎言远离我；使我也不贫穷也不富足；赐给我需用的饮食，
30.en: Keep falsehood and lies far from me; give me neither poverty nor riches, but give me only my daily bread.

30.zh: 恐怕我饱足不认你，说：耶和华是谁呢？又恐怕我贫穷就偷窃，以致亵渎我神的名。
30.en: Otherwise, I may have too much and disown you and say, 'Who is the Lord ?' Or I may become poor and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

30.zh: 你不要向主人谗谤仆人，恐怕他咒诅你，你便算为有罪。
30.en: "Do not slander a servant to his master, or he will curse you, and you will pay for it.

30.zh: 有一宗人（宗：原文是代；下同），咒诅父亲，不给母亲祝福。
30.en: "There are those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers;

30.zh: 有一宗人，自以为清洁，却没有洗去自己的污秽。
30.en: those who are pure in their own eyes and yet are not cleansed of their filth;

30.zh: 有一宗人，眼目何其高傲，眼皮也是高举。
30.en: those whose eyes are ever so haughty, whose glances are so disdainful;

30.zh: 有一宗人，牙如剑，齿如刀，要吞灭地上的困苦人和世间的穷乏人。
30.en: those whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are set with knives to devour the poor from the earth, the needy from among mankind.

30.zh: 蚂蟥有两个女儿，常说：给呀，给呀！有三样不知足的，连不说够的共有四样：
30.en: "The leech has two daughters. 'Give! Give!' they cry. "There are three things that are never satisfied, four that never say, 'Enough!':

30.zh: 就是阴间和石胎，浸水不足的地，并火。
30.en: the grave, the barren womb, land, which is never satisfied with water, and fire, which never says, 'Enough!'

30.zh: 戏笑父亲 、 藐视而不听从母亲的，他的眼睛必为谷中的乌鸦啄出来，为鹰雏所吃。
30.en: "The eye that mocks a father, that scorns obedience to a mother, will be pecked out by the ravens of the valley, will be eaten by the vultures.

30.zh: 我所测不透的奇妙有三样，连我所不知道的共有四样：
30.en: "There are three things that are too amazing for me, four that I do not understand:

30.zh: 就是鹰在空中飞的道；蛇在磐石上爬的道；船在海中行的道；男与女交合的道。
30.en: the way of an eagle in the sky, the way of a snake on a rock, the way of a ship on the high seas, and the way of a man with a maiden.

30.zh: 淫妇的道也是这样：他吃了，把嘴一擦就说：我没有行恶。
30.en: "This is the way of an adulteress: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, 'I've done nothing wrong.'

30.zh: 使地震动的有三样，连地担不起的共有四样：
30.en: "Under three things the earth trembles, under four it cannot bear up:

30.zh: 就是仆人作王；愚顽人吃饱；
30.en: a servant who becomes king, a fool who is full of food,

30.zh: 丑恶的女子出嫁；婢女接续主母。
30.en: an unloved woman who is married, and a maidservant who displaces her mistress.

30.zh: 地上有四样小物，却甚聪明：
30.en: "Four things on earth are small, yet they are extremely wise:

30.zh: 蚂蚁是无力之类，却在夏天预备粮食。
30.en: Ants are creatures of little strength, yet they store up their food in the summer;

30.zh: 沙番是软弱之类，却在磐石中造房。
30.en: coneys are creatures of little power, yet they make their home in the crags;

30.zh: 蝗虫没有君王，却分队而出。
30.en: locusts have no king, yet they advance together in ranks;

30.zh: 守宫用爪抓墙，却住在王宫。
30.en: a lizard can be caught with the hand, yet it is found in kings' palaces.

30.zh: 步行威武的有三样，连行走威武的共有四样：
30.en: "There are three things that are stately in their stride, four that move with stately bearing:

30.zh: 就是狮子 ─ 乃百兽中最为猛烈 、 无所躲避的，
30.en: a lion, mighty among beasts, who retreats before nothing;

30.zh: 猎狗，公山羊，和无人能敌的君王。
30.en: a strutting rooster, a he-goat, and a king with his army around him.

30.zh: 你若行事愚顽，自高自傲，或是怀了恶念，就当用手摀口。
30.en: "If you have played the fool and exalted yourself, or if you have planned evil, clap your hand over your mouth!

30.zh: 摇牛奶必成奶油；扭鼻子必出血。照样，激动怒气必起争端。
30.en: For as churning the milk produces butter, and as twisting the nose produces blood, so stirring up anger produces strife."

31.zh: 利慕伊勒王的言语，是他母亲教训他的真言。
31.en: The sayings of King Lemuel-anoracle his mother taught him:

31.zh: 我的儿啊，我腹中生的儿啊，我许愿得的儿啊！我当怎样教训你呢？
31.en: "O my son, O son of my womb, O son of my vows,

31.zh: 不要将你的精力给妇女；也不要有败坏君王的行为。
31.en: do not spend your strength on women, your vigor on those who ruin kings.

31.zh: 利慕伊勒啊，君王喝酒，君王喝酒不相宜；王子说浓酒在那里也不相宜；
31.en: "It is not for kings, O Lemuel- not for kings to drink wine, not for rulers to crave beer,

31.zh: 恐怕喝了就忘记律例，颠倒一切困苦人的是非。
31.en: lest they drink and forget what the law decrees, and deprive all the oppressed of their rights.

31.zh: 可以把浓酒给将亡的人喝，把清酒给苦心的人喝，
31.en: Give beer to those who are perishing, wine to those who are in anguish;

31.zh: 让他喝了，就忘记他的贫穷，不再记念他的苦楚。
31.en: let them drink and forget their poverty and remember their misery no more.

31.zh: 你当为哑巴（或译：不能自辩的）开口，为一切孤独的伸冤。
31.en: "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute.

31.zh: 你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。
31.en: Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy." Epilogue: The Wife of Noble Character

31.zh: 才德的妇人谁能得著呢？他的价值远胜过珍珠。
31.en: A wife of noble character who can find? She is worth far more than rubies.

31.zh: 他丈夫心里倚靠他，必不缺少利益 . ；
31.en: Her husband has full confidence in her and lacks nothing of value.

31.zh: 他一生使丈夫有益无损。
31.en: She brings him good, not harm, all the days of her life.

31.zh: 他寻找羊绒和麻，甘心用手做工。
31.en: She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands.

31.zh: 他好像商船从远方运粮来，
31.en: She is like the merchant ships, bringing her food from afar.

31.zh: 未到黎明他就起来，把食物分给家中的人，将当做的工分派婢女。
31.en: She gets up while it is still dark; she provides food for her family and portions for her servant girls.

31.zh: 他想得田地就买来；用手所得之利栽种葡萄园。
31.en: She considers a field and buys it; out of her earnings she plants a vineyard.

31.zh: 他以能力束腰，使膀臂有力。
31.en: She sets about her work vigorously; her arms are strong for her tasks.

31.zh: 他觉得所经营的有利；他的灯终夜不灭
31.en: She sees that her trading is profitable, and her lamp does not go out at night.

31.zh: 他手拿撚线竿，手把纺线车。
31.en: In her hand she holds the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers.

31.zh: 他张手赒济困苦人，伸手帮补穷乏人。
31.en: She opens her arms to the poor and extends her hands to the needy.

31.zh: 他不因下雪为家里的人担心，因为全家都穿著朱红衣服。
31.en: When it snows, she has no fear for her household; for all of them are clothed in scarlet.

31.zh: 他为自己制作绣花毯子；他的衣服是细麻和紫色布作的。
31.en: She makes coverings for her bed; she is clothed in fine linen and purple.

31.zh: 他丈夫在城门口与本地的长老同坐，为众人所认识。
31.en: Her husband is respected at the city gate, where he takes his seat among the elders of the land.

31.zh: 他做细麻布衣裳出卖，又将腰带卖与商家。
31.en: She makes linen garments and sells them, and supplies the merchants with sashes.

31.zh: 能力和威仪是他的衣服；他想到日后的景况就喜笑。
31.en: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.

31.zh: 他开口就发智慧；他舌上有仁慈的法则。
31.en: She speaks with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.

31.zh: 他观察家务，并不吃闲饭。
31.en: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.

31.zh: 他的儿女起来，称他有福；他的丈夫也称赞他，
31.en: Her children arise and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her:

31.zh: 说：才德的女子很多，惟独你超过一切。
31.en: "Many women do noble things, but you surpass them all."

31.zh: 艳丽是虚假的，美容是虚浮的；惟敬畏耶和华的妇女必得称赞。
31.en: Charm is deceptive, and beauty is fleeting; but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised.

31.zh: 愿他享受操作所得的；愿他的工作在城门口荣耀他。
